fields.description_zh:
確認申報醫院之醫事機構代碼。
欄位位置：1–10
fields.description_en:
Confirm the healthcare facility code of the reporting hospital.
Field position: 1–10
fields.purpose_zh: 確認申報醫院。
fields.guide_zh: 各家醫院均有醫事機構代碼，依申報醫院之「健保申報代碼」填入。
fields.purpose_en: Confirms the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en: Every hospital has a healthcare facility code; enter the reporting hospital's "NHI claim code".

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院之病歷號碼。
欄位位置：11–20
fields.description_en:
Record the medical record number of the case at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 11–20
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案及作為調閱病歷之依據；亦可作為辨識個案是否有多重原發腫瘤之依據。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案在申報醫院之病歷號碼。
• 若病歷號碼少於10碼，則直接填入病歷號碼，資料向左靠、後面留空白；若有英文字母請大寫。
• 若病歷號碼未知，則編碼為9999999999。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case and as the basis for retrieving medical records; can also be used to identify whether the case has multiple primary tumors.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's medical record number at the reporting hospital.
• If the medical record number has fewer than 10 characters, enter it directly, left-justified with trailing blanks; use capital letters for any letters.
• If the medical record number is unknown, code 9999999999.

fields.description_zh:
填寫個案的姓名。
欄位位置：21–30
fields.description_en:
Enter the name of the case.
Field position: 21–30
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:
• 本欄位不可空白，若不知道個案的姓名，則編碼為不詳。
• 若電腦中無此字，請用「？」全形字體替代；字與字中間不可空白。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en:
• This field must not be blank; if the case's name is not known, code it as "unknown" (the Chinese word for unknown).
• If a character is not available in the computer, replace it with a full-width "？"; no spaces are allowed between characters.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案的身分證統一編號。
欄位位置：31–40
fields.description_en:
Record the national ID number of the case.
Field position: 31–40
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案的身分證統一編號。
• 身分證統一編號應確實詳填，並需與性別符合，身分證統一編號英文字母後第一位數字若為1則為男性，2則為女性。
• 身分證統一編號若不詳，應設法透過各種管道查證，如：詳閱病歷資料(住院許可證、手術同意書、護理紀錄單等)、醫院電腦系統、或直接向個案及相關人員查詢等。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's national identification number.
• The national identification number must be filled in accurately and consistent with sex; if the first digit after the letter of the national identification number is 1, the patient is male, and if 2, female.
• If the national identification number is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, such as: reviewing medical record data (admission permit, surgical consent form, nursing records, etc.), the hospital computer system, or inquiring directly with the patient and related persons.

fields.description_zh:
確認個案的性別。
欄位位置：41–41
fields.description_en:
Confirm the sex of the case.
Field position: 41–41
fields.purpose_zh: 可作為各癌症部位性別比例及預後之比較。個案若有多重原發，其病歷紀錄上的性別都應相同。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄病歷上個案的性別。
• 需注意個案性別應與其身分證統一編號性別碼相符合。
• 編碼4：變性人(transsexual)係指經手術方式改變原本之性別。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to compare sex ratios and prognosis by cancer site. If a case has multiple primaries, the sex recorded in the medical record should be the same.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's sex as documented in the medical record.
• Note that the patient's sex should be consistent with the sex code of the national identification number.
• Code 4: Transsexual (transsexual) refers to a person whose original sex has been changed surgically.

fields.description_zh:
確認個案的出生日期。
欄位位置：42–49
fields.description_en:
Confirm the date of birth of the case.
Field position: 42–49
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於確認個案的身份；對於以個案世代研究(patient cohort)作為腫瘤分析也很有幫助。
fields.guide_zh:
• 依病歷上所記載來記錄個案的出生日期。
• 若出生日期不詳者，應設法透過各種管道查證，或直接與個案或相關人員查詢。
• 民國年換算為西元年，年度為民國前者，以「1912」減民國前年度；民國後，以「1911」加民國年度。例如民前5年為西元1907年，民國5年則為西元1916年。年 月 日使用4位數字的西元年 01 1 月 01 9999 年不詳 02 2 月 02 03 3 月 03 … … … … 10 10 月 29 11 11 月 30 12 12 月 31 99 月不詳 99 日不詳範例：編碼：案例
19060630：個案出生日期為民國前 6年 6月30日。
19409999：個案在民國 89 年 6 月 15 日時是 60 歲，在病歷記錄中並無記載其出生日期。則記錄月份和日期未知(分別為 99, 99)，並推算其出生年份為民國 29年。
19279999：病歷上僅記載個案之出生年份是民國 16年。
fields.purpose_en: Helps confirm the case's identity; also useful for tumor analysis using a patient cohort.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's date of birth as documented in the medical record.
• If the date of birth is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, or inquire directly with the patient or related persons.
• To convert ROC years to AD years: for years before the ROC era, subtract the year before ROC from "1912"; for years in the ROC era, add the ROC year to "1911". For example, 5 years before ROC is AD 1907, and ROC year 5 is AD 1916. Year Month Day Use 4-digit AD years 01 January 01 9999 year unknown 02 February 02 03 March 03 … … … … 10 October 29 11 November 30 12 December 31 99 month unknown 99 day unknown Examples: Code: Case
19060630: The patient's date of birth is June 30, 6 years before ROC (1906).
19409999: The patient was 60 years old on June 15, ROC 89 (2000), and the medical record does not document the date of birth. Record the month and day as unknown (99 and 99, respectively), and estimate the year of birth as ROC 29 (1940).
19279999: The medical record documents only that the patient's year of birth was ROC 16 (1927).

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在診斷為癌症時之戶籍地代碼。
欄位位置：50–53
fields.description_en:
Record the registered household address code of the case at the time of cancer diagnosis.
Field position: 50–53
fields.purpose_zh: 為個案流行病學之地域資料，並可作為癌症群聚或環境因素研究分析。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄身分證上戶籍地址之鄉鎮市區代碼，依附錄A「戶籍地代碼表」填入。
• 病歷上若有二個(含)以上地址時，應予以詳細查明，勿任意填選。癌症確認
fields.purpose_en: Epidemiological geographic data on the case, which can be used for analysis of cancer clusters or environmental factors.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the township/district code of the registered household address on the identity card, filled in according to Appendix A “Registered household address code table”.
• If the medical record has two or more addresses, find out the details carefully and do not choose arbitrarily. Cancer confirmation

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案診斷此癌症時之實足年齡。
欄位位置：54–56
fields.description_en:
Record the age in completed years of the case at diagnosis of this cancer.
Field position: 54–56
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於個案的確認，且對於統計分析癌症相關資料時，年齡常是一個重要的因素。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案診斷為此癌症時的實足年齡。
• 若個案有多個原發癌症，診斷年齡應該依不同原發而個別計算。
• 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，診斷年齡為000。
fields.purpose_en: Helps identify the case, and age is often an important factor in statistical analysis of cancer-related data.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's age in completed years at the time of diagnosis of this cancer.
• If the patient has multiple primary cancers, the age at diagnosis should be calculated separately for each primary.
• If a patient was diagnosed with cancer in utero (in utero diagnosis) on or after 1 January 2010, the age at diagnosis is 000.

fields.description_zh:
指個案一生中所罹患惡性腫瘤的發生順序。
欄位位置：57–58
fields.description_en:
Indicates the order of occurrence of the malignant tumors the case has had over a lifetime.
Field position: 57–58
fields.purpose_zh: 可用來選擇單一原發腫瘤個案及進行特定的追蹤研究，並可分析發生多發腫瘤的因子。
fields.guide_zh:
• 編碼01代表個案的第1個惡性腫瘤，而後續腫瘤的譯碼數字則依序類推。
• 如果同時診斷出2個或2個以上的惡性腫瘤或原位癌時，則預後最差的診斷給予最低順序的號碼。若其預後沒有差異性，則順序號碼的決定就沒有硬性規定。
• 若申報醫院在稍後得知有尚未登錄的腫瘤且會影響到腫瘤發生的順序，則應該要再重新編腫瘤發生順序號碼。範例：編碼：案例
01：個案以前並無癌症病史，在民國 92年6月13日診斷出有乳房原位癌。
02：個案在民國 92 年 6 月 13 日診斷為乳癌，之後在民國 92 年 8 月 30 日診斷為皮膚黑色素瘤之癌症發生順序號碼。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to select single-primary-tumor cases for specific follow-up studies, and to analyze factors in the occurrence of multiple tumors.
fields.guide_en:
• Code 01 represents the patient's first malignant tumor, and the codes for subsequent tumors follow in order.
• If two or more malignant tumors or carcinomas in situ are diagnosed at the same time, the diagnosis with the worst prognosis is given the lowest sequence number. If there is no difference in prognosis, there is no fixed rule for deciding the sequence number.
• If the reporting hospital later learns of an unregistered tumor that affects the sequence in which the tumors occurred, the tumor sequence numbers should be reassigned. Examples: Code: Case
01: The patient had no previous history of cancer and was diagnosed with carcinoma in situ of the breast on 13 June ROC year 92 (2003).
02: The patient was diagnosed with breast cancer on 13 June ROC year 92 (2003), and was later diagnosed on 30 August ROC year 92 (2003) with melanoma of the skin; this is the cancer sequence number.

fields.description_zh:
將個案進行分類。
欄位位置：59–59
fields.description_en:
Classify the case.
Field position: 59–59
fields.purpose_zh: 在做治療和存活分析時，本欄位將個案分為可分析和不可分析個案兩類。進而提供申報醫院進行研究個案之選擇。
fields.guide_zh:
• 個案分類包括0、1、2、3、5、7、8、9共8類。可分析治療和存活的個案編碼為1-2；不可分析個案編碼為0，3-9。
• 癌症診療臨床情境可以非常錯綜複雜，癌症登記師在申報個案資料時，必須參考在規定申報期限內所有相關的病歷資料，以完成正確個案分類。
• 個案分類的編碼必須經由綜合判斷「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」兩個新欄位的編碼，方能正確的摘錄。
• Class 1 及 Class 2 個案必須詳細申報所有項目。
• Class 0 個案不需申報欄位序號#7.1~7.5，以”9”補滿。
• Class 3 個案不需申報欄位序號#7.1~7.5，以”9”補滿。
• 於申報醫院診斷並於申報醫院訂定首次療程為不予治療的個案，個案分類編碼是1，不可編碼為0。
• 雙碼分類為12、15、16、19的Class 0個案，必須是在申報期限內，確實未於申報醫院接受任何治療，方能以上述分類申報。
• Class 0中雙碼分類為12的個案，申報醫院必須確認個案接受後續診療的醫院，方能以雙碼12申報此個案。
• 可分析個案Analytic case :雙碼11、13、14個案(class 1)及21、23、24個案(class 2)。
• 不可分析個案Non-analytic case: 雙碼10、12、15、16、19個案 (class 0) 及雙碼20、22、25、26、27、29、30、32、34、35、36、37、39個案 (class 3)
• 不需申報個案: 個案分類為編碼 7、8 者，不需申報。
• 於他院診斷，但為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診之個案，不需申報。
• 首次療程與後續治療定義請詳見總論說明。
• 根據「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」綜合判斷「2.3個案分類 」：範例：個案：診斷 治療分類：狀態 狀態案例編碼：分類 分類編碼：編碼
0：1 0 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案因病情急速惡化，未能接受任何治療即死亡。
0：1 2 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案自動出院，申報醫院僅獲知個案已自行前往 B 醫院，但申報醫院未能得知個案在B 醫院的診療詳情。
0：1 5 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，後續追蹤獲知個案服用中草藥治療肺癌。
0：1 5 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；個案於最初診斷日第三個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因陰道不正常出血至申報醫院檢查，經子宮內膜刮除(D & C)切片證實為子宮內膜癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案拒絕；於最初診斷日一年後，個案回診並重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，且接受手術切除。
0：1 6 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案未接受該治療；個案於最初診斷日第五個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，並拒絕追蹤。
0：1 9 個案因乳房腫塊，到申報醫院接受切片證實為原發性乳癌，但個案失聯且無法追蹤。個案：診斷 治療分類：狀態 狀態案例編碼：分類 分類編碼：編碼
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，且在申報醫院接受手術及放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但因為充血性心衰竭治療，個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，才接受手術切除仍為臨床期別第一期的肺癌。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案猶豫不決；個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並同意接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案未接受；於最初診斷日六個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並進行放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因腹痛至申報醫院，腹部超音波發現個案脾臟腫大且抽血發現紅血球過高，再經由JAK2 檢驗被醫師診斷為真性多紅血球症(Polycythemia vera，PV)；為使紅血球數降低個案在申報醫院接受放血治療(phlebotomy)，且因合併脾臟腫大接受口服化學治療。
1：1 1 個案因貧血而到申報醫院，經由抽血、骨髓切片檢查被醫師診斷為 Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)，在申報醫院先接受Retinoid acid (ATRA） 及類固醇藥物再進行化療治療。

fields.purpose_en: For treatment and survival analysis, this field classifies cases as analytic or non-analytic, thereby helping the reporting hospital select cases for research.
fields.guide_en:
• The case class includes 8 classes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9. Cases with class 1-2 are analyzable for treatment and survival; non-analytic cases are coded 0 and 3-9.
• Clinical situations in cancer care can be very complex; when reporting case data, the cancer registrar must refer to all relevant medical records within the specified reporting deadline in order to complete the correct case class.
• The case class code must be abstracted correctly by jointly judging the codes of the two new fields “2.3.1 Diagnostic status classification” and “2.3.2 Treatment status classification”.
• Class 1 and Class 2 cases must be reported in detail for all items.
• Class 0 cases do not need to report field serial numbers #7.1~7.5; fill them with “9”.
• Class 3 cases do not need to report field serial numbers #7.1~7.5; fill them with “9”.
• For a case diagnosed at the reporting hospital whose first course of treatment is determined at the reporting hospital to be no treatment, the case class code is 1 and must not be coded 0.
• Class 0 cases with double-digit classification 12, 15, 16 or 19 may be reported with these classifications only if the case definitely received no treatment at the reporting hospital within the reporting deadline.
• For a Class 0 case with double-digit classification 12, the reporting hospital must confirm the hospital where the case received subsequent care before reporting the case as double-digit 12.
• Analytic cases: double-digit 11, 13, 14 cases (class 1) and 21, 23, 24 cases (class 2).
• Non-analytic cases: double-digit 10, 12, 15, 16, 19 cases (class 0) and double-digit 20, 22, 25, 26, 27, 29, 30, 32, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39 cases (class 3)
• Cases not to be reported: cases with case class code 7 or 8 do not need to be reported.
• Cases diagnosed at another facility that come to the reporting hospital for other diseases do not need to be reported.
• For the definitions of first course of treatment and subsequent treatment, see the general introduction.

fields.purpose_zh: 與新增欄位2.3.1「診斷狀態分類」並用，以確保欄位 2.3「個案分類」的正確性。此欄位並協助記錄個案未於申報醫院接受首次療程的原因，以協助申報醫院改善管理個案流失；並提供此數據作為公衛行政資源調整的依據。
fields.guide_zh:
• 如果病歷中沒有治療計畫、也沒有制定好的治療或處置指引可供參考，同時無法諮詢到主責醫師時，請參考以下原則：「首次療程必須起始於最初診斷日期的四個月之內」。
• 治療狀態分類編碼2(他院診療)、5(接受另類療法)、6 (拒絕治療)、9(失聯或首次療程不詳)的優先順序依次為2、5、6、9。
• 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，視為申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程，編碼為113。
• 申報醫院若僅被委託執行部分放射治療，則視為申報醫院沒有執行首次療程，應編碼為322。
• 治療狀態分類編碼4為醫師決定不予以治療、再密切觀察(Watchful observation)、僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制(pain control)、支持療法(supportive care)或轉介安寧照護。例如：若攝護腺癌個案僅接受TURP，後續醫生選擇積極監測(Active surveillance)或予以密切觀察(Watchful waiting)，「治療狀態分類」編碼為4。
• 若個案僅接受其他治療，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為1，下列處置為「治療狀態分類」欄位所定義之其他治療： UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY. Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY 非肝癌個案執行TAE治療。注意: 其他治療若後續有新增處置，將以SEER 網站上之藥物查詢工具為依據:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/。 檢索藥物時，若藥劑類別(category)顯示為 Other therapy 時，則視為其他治療。 藥劑類別若已清楚明示 (e.g. chemotherapy)，則將該藥物摘錄至適當治療欄位。 若無法在SEER*Rx 查詢到之藥物，請勿直接摘錄為其他治療，應先諮詢主責醫師。
• 根據Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manua第24頁，"輸血"不視為癌症治療，而是症狀緩解，故「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way.
• 「治療狀態分類」欄位編碼4與6之釐清： 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，但接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，且未接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為6。
• 治療狀態分類編碼5中所指的另類治療為本手冊未規範定義之各種療法，而且個案自行認定該療法對癌症有療效的治療。這些另類療法包括，但不僅限定於中草藥、氣功、生機療法及個案在未參與癌症診療認證合格的診所或醫療機構所接受被宣稱具有療效的免疫療法。
• 治療狀態分類編碼7(他院診療)必須伴隨診斷狀況分類碼為2或3。範例：
• 詳見2.3「個案分類」編碼案例
fields.purpose_en: Used together with the newly added field 2.3.1 "Diagnosis status category" to ensure the accuracy of field 2.3 "Case category". This field also helps record the reason the case did not receive the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital, to help the reporting hospital improve management of lost cases, and provides these data as a basis for adjusting public health administrative resources.
fields.guide_en:
• If the medical record has no treatment plan and no established treatment or management guideline for reference, and the attending physician cannot be consulted, use the following principle: "the first course of treatment must start within four months of the date of initial diagnosis".
• The order of priority of treatment status class codes 2 (care at another facility), 5 (alternative therapy received), 6 (treatment refused) and 9 (lost to contact or first course of treatment unknown) is 2, 5, 6, 9.
• If the reporting hospital commissioned another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, this is regarded as the case receiving part of the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and part of the first course of treatment at another facility; code 113.
• If the reporting hospital was only commissioned to perform part of the radiotherapy, it is regarded as the reporting hospital not having performed the first course of treatment; code 322.
• Treatment status class code 4 is for: the physician decides not to treat, watchful observation, only palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, or referral to hospice care. For example: if a prostate cancer case receives only TURP and the physician subsequently chooses active surveillance or watchful waiting, code "Treatment status class" as 4.
• If the case receives only other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 1. The following procedures are defined as other therapy for the "Treatment status class" field: UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY. Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. TAE performed in a non-liver cancer case. Note: if procedures are later added to other therapy, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website will be used as the basis:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/. When searching for a drug, if the category is shown as Other therapy, it is regarded as other therapy. If the category is clearly stated (e.g. chemotherapy), abstract the drug into the appropriate treatment field. If a drug cannot be found in SEER*Rx, do not directly abstract it as other therapy; consult the attending physician first.
• According to page 24 of the Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual, "blood transfusion" is not regarded as cancer treatment but as symptom relief, so the "Treatment status class" field should be coded 4. Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way.
• Clarification of codes 4 and 6 of the "Treatment status class" field: if the case refuses the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guideline but receives palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 4. If the case refuses the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guideline and does not receive palliative surgery that does not resect the tumor, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other therapy, code the "Treatment status class" field as 6.
• Alternative therapy referred to in treatment status class code 5 means various therapies not defined in this manual that the case himself/herself regards as effective against cancer. These alternative therapies include, but are not limited to, Chinese herbal medicine, qigong, biological/natural therapy, and immunotherapy claimed to be effective received at clinics or medical institutions not accredited for cancer care.
• Treatment status class code 7 (care at another facility) must be accompanied by diagnostic status class code 2 or 3. Examples:

個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。

Earliest date the case came to the reporting hospital as an outpatient or inpatient for this cancer.

fields.purpose_zh: 可用來計算個案首次就診至進行癌症登記之時間間隔；也可用來計算首次就診至治療之時間差距，以作為監控癌症照護品質之用。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
• 本欄位可以是個案於門診作切片檢查、放射線檢查、實驗室檢查的日期。
• 若個案由屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症(個案分類為5)或僅由死亡證明書診斷為癌症(個案分類為8)，則以死亡日期作為首次就診日期。範例：編碼：案例
20040212：個案於民國93年2月12日在申報醫院門診接受乳房攝影檢查結果懷疑是惡性，之後於民國 93年2月14日作切除性切片檢查(excisional biopsy)或根除性手術。則乳房攝影的日期(民國93 年2月12日)即為個案之首次就診日期。
20030914：個案於民國 92年9月8日在私人診所中作切片檢查，其病理標本送至申報醫院判讀為惡性黑色素瘤。個案於民國 92 年 9 月 14 日在申報醫院進行廣泛性再切除手術。
20041207：個案因嚴重頭痛和失去方向感等症狀，於民國 93 年 12 月 7 日接受腦部磁振造影檢查懷疑是星狀細胞瘤，於民國 93年12月19 日接受手術切除全部的腫瘤。
20050999：住進申報醫院的確切日期不詳，只知道是民國94 年9月。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to calculate the interval from the case's first visit to cancer registration; can also be used to calculate the interval from first visit to treatment, for monitoring the quality of cancer care.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the earliest date on which the case came to the reporting hospital outpatient clinic or was admitted because of this cancer.
• This field may be the date of a biopsy, radiological examination or laboratory test at the outpatient clinic.
• If the case was diagnosed with cancer at autopsy (case classification 5) or only from the death certificate (case classification 8), use the date of death as the date of first visit. Examples: Code: Case

The mammography date (February 12, ROC year 93) is then the case's date of first visit.

Record the date this cancer was first diagnosed by a physician.
Field position: 70–77
fields.purpose_zh: 可計算癌症最初診斷日期至完成分期或開始治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
• 最初診斷日期可以是臨床或病理上診斷為癌症的開始日期。亦即「個案在申報醫院或外院被醫師診斷為癌症(或疑似癌症)的第一天」。需注意本欄位日期一定小於或等於「最後聯絡或死亡日期」。
• 若細胞學檢查(cytology)報告中使用含糊不清的詞彙，例如”suspicious for malignancy”只有在切片檢查為陽性或醫師有臨床判斷並支持此細胞學檢查時，才可編碼為最初診斷日期。
• 若僅是異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症確診方式，需採用臨床判斷、病理或細胞學檢查確認陽性的日期，才可作為最初診斷日期，不可回推至該腫瘤指標採檢日為最初診斷日期。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片( fine needle biopsy)，病理報告結果為adenocarcinoma；則最初診斷日期應為切片日期(不可將PSA報告日或是採檢日作為最初診斷日期)。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生於病歷上描述懷疑病人有攝護腺癌並建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片，切片結果為陽性，證實醫生的懷疑；則最初診斷日期應摘錄醫生描述懷疑為攝護腺癌的日期。注意︰僅有異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症最初診斷日期。
• 若特定癌別之影像報告和數據系統(Imaging Reporting and Data System, RADS)分類結果符合下列可申報條件，且後續經切片檢查為陽性或醫師有臨床判斷並支持此檢查報告時，該影像檢查日期可視為最初診斷日期。RADS可申報分類有： 肝癌LI-RADS 分類4、5 攝護腺癌PI-RADS 分類4、5 乳癌BI-RADS 分類4、4A、4B、4C、5 肺癌Lung-RADS 分類4A、4B、4X例如：個案接受乳房篩檢，其乳房攝影結果BI-RADS分類為4C。後續至醫院接受切片，證實為乳房原位癌，則個案最初診斷日期應摘錄BI-RADS影像檢查日期。
• 個案經診斷為白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)者： 疑似癌症的日期不可摘錄為最初診斷日期。 注意：白血病個案若周邊血液(peripheral blood) blast≧20%，雖然醫師於病歷描述為 rule out leukemia，仍可視為確診。(此適用於 2023診斷年之前個案) 僅單次全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告確診，或多份報告但醫師明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則以該次採檢日為最初診斷日期。 有多次不足以確診之全血球計數或白血球計數報告時，醫師亦未明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則採用醫師診斷為癌症的日期作為最初診斷日期。 若全血球計數或白血球計數報告不足以確診為癌症，且醫師亦未確診癌症，經骨髓或其他切片檢查結果確診為癌症時，則以病理採檢日期為最初診斷日期。 若病理或細胞學報告均無法判斷為癌症時，以醫師診斷為癌症的日期為最初診斷日期。
• 個案在確定診斷之前就已接受首次療程，若無最初診斷日期，則可以治療開始的日期作為最初診斷日期。
• 有關作為癌症診斷的用語，可參考第一部份的「含糊不清詞彙」表列的內容。
• 個案分類為5者，其最初診斷日期即為死亡日期。
• 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，其最初診斷日期請填正確診斷或接受治療的日期；若是2010年以前之個案，則最初診斷日期請填出生日期。
• 若個案曾在外院診斷為癌症而日期不詳者，儘可能推算至月份；月份不詳者，請依下列原則編碼： 年度、季節可推算，但月份無法推算：年度依推算編碼；月份依季節編碼，春季為0499、夏季為0799、秋季為1099、冬季為1299(年尾)或0199(年初)。若診斷月份無法推算，則編碼為9999。 若院外最初診斷日期年、月、日皆不詳，則不須申報。範例：編碼：案例
20050312：民國 94 年 3 月 12 日的乳房攝影檢查顯示，個案右邊乳房的外上四分之一處有癌症(compatible with carcinoma)。民國94年 3月20日個案接受乳房切除性切片檢查確診為浸潤性管道癌(infiltrating ductal carcinoma)。
20030512：醫師記載個案在民國 92 年 5 月 12 日體檢時發現攝護腺有結節且懷疑是癌症。民國 92 年 6 月 15 日做攝護腺超音波導引的細針切片檢查(ultrasound guided needle biopsy)，結果確診為腺癌(adenocarcinoma)。
20040199：個案於民國 93 年 1 月因子宮內膜異位(endometriosis)而接受經腹部全子宮切除術(total abdominal hysterectomy)。於民國 94 年11月因腹痛、腹脹而住院，經腹腔鏡行網膜切片檢查(laparoscopy with omental biopsy)結果顯示為轉移性囊狀腺癌(metastatic cystadenocarcinoma)。病理醫師重新調閱民國 93 年子宮切除的標本，確認在左側卵巢有囊狀腺癌。
20059999：若最初診斷的確切日期不詳，則記錄其約略的日期，例如只知道是民國 94年。
20110904：個案於民國 100年 9 月1 日進行CBC/WBC 檢查，醫師於 9月 3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國 100 年 9 月 4 日再經骨髓切片之histology 結果確診為AML。
20110903：個案於民國 100 年 9 月 1 日進行 CBC/WBC 檢查且 blasts=18%，醫師未下診斷為癌症或疑似癌症，民國 100年9月3日再經骨髓切片之histology結果確診為 AML。
20110902：個案於民國 100 年9月 1 日進行CBC/WBC 檢查，結果有疑異，民國 100 年9 月 2 日再經抽血進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國 100 年 9 月 5 日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110901：個案於民國 100 年9月 1 日進行CBC/WBC 檢查，結果有疑異，醫師將 9 月1 日的血液樣本，於 9 月 2 日申請對該異常檢體進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國 100 年 9 月 5 日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110904：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查，醫師於 9月3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國100年 9月4日開始化學治療。
fields.purpose_en: Allows calculation of the time interval from the initial cancer diagnosis date to completion of staging or start of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
• The date of initial diagnosis may be the start date of the clinical or pathologic diagnosis of cancer, that is, "the first day on which the case was diagnosed with cancer (or suspected cancer) by a physician at the reporting hospital or another facility". Note that the date in this field must be earlier than or equal to the "Date of last contact or death".
• If a cytology report uses vague terms, such as "suspicious for malignancy", it may be coded as the date of initial diagnosis only if the biopsy is positive or the physician's clinical judgment supports the cytology finding.
• Abnormal tumor markers alone cannot be regarded as a method of cancer confirmation; the date of clinical judgment, or of positive pathology or cytology confirmation, must be used as the date of initial diagnosis, and it must not be traced back to the tumor marker collection date. Example: A case has elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician recommends fine needle biopsy of the prostate, and the pathology report is adenocarcinoma; the date of initial diagnosis should be the biopsy date (not the PSA report date or collection date). Example: A case has elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician writes in the medical record that prostate cancer is suspected and recommends fine needle biopsy of the prostate, and the biopsy result is positive, confirming the physician's suspicion; the date of initial diagnosis should be the date on which the physician described suspected prostate cancer. Note: abnormal tumor markers alone cannot be regarded as the date of initial diagnosis of cancer.
• If the Imaging Reporting and Data System (RADS) category of a specific cancer meets the following reportable conditions, and the subsequent biopsy is positive or the physician's clinical judgment supports the imaging report, the date of that imaging examination may be regarded as the date of initial diagnosis. Reportable RADS categories: liver cancer LI-RADS category 4, 5; prostate cancer PI-RADS category 4, 5; breast cancer BI-RADS category 4, 4A, 4B, 4C, 5; lung cancer Lung-RADS category 4A, 4B, 4X. Example: A case underwent breast screening and the mammography result was BI-RADS category 4C. The case later had a biopsy at a hospital that confirmed breast carcinoma in situ; the date of initial diagnosis should be abstracted as the date of the BI-RADS imaging examination.
• For a case diagnosed with leukemia or another hematologic neoplasm (excluding lymphoma): the date of suspected cancer must not be abstracted as the date of initial diagnosis. Note: for a leukemia case with peripheral blood blast ≧20%, even if the physician described it in the medical record as rule out leukemia, it may be regarded as confirmed. (This applies to cases diagnosed before 2023.) If a single complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) report confirms the diagnosis, or there are multiple reports but the physician explicitly states that the cancer was diagnosed on the basis of one report, the collection date of that report is the date of initial diagnosis. If there are multiple CBC or WBC reports that are insufficient for diagnosis and the physician does not explicitly state that the cancer was diagnosed on the basis of one report, use the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer as the date of initial diagnosis. If the CBC or WBC reports are insufficient to confirm cancer and the physician has not confirmed cancer, and cancer is confirmed by bone marrow or other biopsy, use the pathology specimen collection date as the date of initial diagnosis. If neither pathology nor cytology reports can establish cancer, use the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer as the date of initial diagnosis.
• If the case received the first course of treatment before the diagnosis was established and there is no date of initial diagnosis, the treatment start date may be used as the date of initial diagnosis.
• For terms used in diagnosing cancer, see the "Ambiguous terms" table in Part 1.
• For cases with case class 5, the date of initial diagnosis is the date of death.
• If a case was diagnosed with cancer in utero on or after January 1, 2010 (in utero diagnosis), enter the date of the correct diagnosis or of treatment as the date of initial diagnosis; for cases before 2010, enter the date of birth as the date of initial diagnosis.
• If a case was diagnosed with cancer at another facility with an unknown date, estimate it to the month as far as possible; if the month is unknown, code by the following principles: if the year and season can be estimated but not the month: code the year as estimated, and code the month by season: spring 0499, summer 0799, autumn 1099, winter 1299 (end of year) or 0199 (beginning of year). If the diagnosis month cannot be estimated, code 9999. If the year, month and day of the initial diagnosis at another facility are all unknown, no report is required. Examples: Code: Case
20050312: A mammogram on March 12, ROC year 94 (2005) showed findings compatible with carcinoma in the upper outer quadrant of the case's right breast. On March 20, ROC year 94 (2005), the case underwent excisional biopsy of the breast, which confirmed infiltrating ductal carcinoma.
20030512: The physician recorded that a nodule was found in the prostate at the case's physical examination on May 12, ROC year 92 (2003) and cancer was suspected. On June 15, ROC year 92 (2003), an ultrasound-guided needle biopsy of the prostate was done, which confirmed adenocarcinoma.
20040199: In January of ROC year 93 (2004) the case underwent total abdominal hysterectomy for endometriosis. In November of ROC year 94 (2005) the case was hospitalized for abdominal pain and distension, and laparoscopy with omental biopsy showed metastatic cystadenocarcinoma. The pathologist re-reviewed the specimen from the ROC year 93 (2004) hysterectomy and confirmed cystadenocarcinoma in the left ovary.
20059999: If the exact date of initial diagnosis is unknown, record the approximate date, e.g. when only ROC year 94 (2005) is known.
20110904: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011); on September 3 the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. On September 4, ROC year 100 (2011), histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110903: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with blasts=18%, and the physician did not diagnose cancer or suspected cancer; on September 3, ROC year 100 (2011), histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110902: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with a questionable result; on September 2, ROC year 100 (2011), blood was drawn for immunophenotyping, and on September 5, ROC year 100 (2011), the physician determined AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110901: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011) with a questionable result; the physician requested immunophenotyping of the abnormal specimen from the September 1 blood sample on September 2, and on September 5, ROC year 100 (2011), determined AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110904: The case had a CBC/WBC test on September 1, ROC year 100 (2011); on September 3 the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. Chemotherapy began on September 4, ROC year 100 (2011).

fields.description_zh:
確認癌症原發部位。
欄位位置：78–81
fields.description_en:
Confirm the primary site of the cancer.
Field position: 78–81
fields.purpose_zh: 原發部位是分期及決定治療方針之依據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
• 依ICD-O-3腫瘤部位碼(topography code)進行原發部位編碼。
• 若病歷紀錄並無原發部位之相關資訊，可詢問主責醫師以確認其原發部位或最確切之部位碼。
• 原發部位碼可於ICD-O-3的腫瘤部位章節查詢，共有二種查詢方式：以編碼順序編排(ICD-O-3，第43頁)及依英文字母順序索引(ICD-O-3,第105頁)之章節。
• 腫瘤部位碼是以大寫字母C開頭，之後加上3個數字碼(不記錄小數點)，編碼範圍為C000-C809(”C”為大寫)，不含小數點，第4位盡量查明詳填，實在無法辨識才能填9。
• 有關實質(solid tumors)癌症之編碼規則，遵循ICD-O-3第20-40頁及SEER「Solid Tumor coding rules」。
• 非多重原發個案，若單一解剖部位同時包括侵襲性及原位性病灶於不同細部位，則「原發部位」應以侵襲性部份來編碼。
• 惡性肉瘤（Sarcoma）個案若原發部位不明時，原發部位應編碼C499，而非C809。
• 當單一腫瘤橫跨兩個或兩個以上的細部位(subsite)時，且確切起源亦不清楚，則第4碼應為8。
• 若同一個器官有多顆腫瘤且位於不同細部位時，則第4碼應為9。
• 對於血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer【M9590-9993】)是否為單一或多重原發，請依下列原則編碼： 2010年1月1日(含)以後新診斷個案：應遵循SEER「Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual」最新公告版本與The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB) 之規則編碼。範例：編碼：案例
C108：口咽部(oropharynx)有 overlapping 的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2)和posterior wall of oropharynx(C10.3)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第 4 碼應為8。
C678：膀胱(bladder)有重疊的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括 dome (C67.1)和lateral wall (C67.2)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第 4碼應為8。
C679：Bladder, NOS。當有多顆腫瘤起源自Bladder trigone (C67.0)和lateral wall (C67.2)時，第 4碼應為9。
C189：Colon, NOS。當患有家族性息肉症(Familial polyposis)的個案，從橫結腸(C18.4)到降結腸(C18.6)皆發生有侵襲癌和原位癌時，應記錄為一個原發癌症，部位為colon, NOS (C18.9)。詳細解說請參考第一部份多重原發之章節。
C16_：當淋巴癌位於胃(extranodal lymphoma)時，則以胃的細部位逕行編碼。
fields.purpose_en: The primary site is the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; it also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
• Code the primary site according to the ICD-O-3 topography code.
• If the medical record contains no information on the primary site, ask the attending physician to confirm the primary site or the most accurate site code.
• The primary site code can be looked up in the topography section of ICD-O-3, which offers two ways of looking up: the section arranged in code order (ICD-O-3, page 43) and the alphabetical index (ICD-O-3, page 105).
• The topography code begins with the capital letter C followed by 3 digits (the decimal point is not recorded); the coding range is C000-C809 ("C" must be uppercase), without a decimal point. Identify the 4th digit in as much detail as possible; code 9 only when it truly cannot be determined.
• For coding rules for solid tumors, follow ICD-O-3 pages 20-40 and the SEER "Solid Tumor coding rules".
• In cases that are not multiple primaries, if a single anatomical site contains both invasive and in situ lesions in different subsites, the "primary site" should be coded according to the invasive portion.
• For a malignant sarcoma with an unknown primary site, the primary site should be coded C499, not C809.
• When a single tumor overlaps two or more subsites and the exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
• When there are multiple tumors in the same organ located in different subsites, the 4th digit should be 9.
• Whether a hematopoietic or lymphoid cancer (M9590-9993) is a single or multiple primary should be coded according to the following principle:• For cases newly diagnosed on or after 1 January 2010: follow the rules of the latest release of the SEER "Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual" and The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB). Examples: Code: Case
C108: Overlapping lesion of the oropharynx. For example, when a single large tumor involves both the lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2) and the posterior wall of oropharynx (C10.3) and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C678: Overlapping lesion of the bladder. For example, when a single large tumor involves both the dome (C67.1) and the lateral wall (C67.2) and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C679: Bladder, NOS. When multiple tumors arise from the bladder trigone (C67.0) and the lateral wall (C67.2), the 4th digit should be 9.
C189: Colon, NOS. In a patient with familial polyposis who has both invasive carcinoma and carcinoma in situ from the transverse colon (C18.4) to the descending colon (C18.6), record one primary cancer with site colon, NOS (C18.9). For a detailed explanation, see the section on multiple primaries in Part 1.
C16_: When lymphoma is located in the stomach (extranodal lymphoma), code directly with the subsite of the stomach.

fields.description_zh:
確認癌症起源於成對器官或身體的某一側。本欄位只適用於原發腫瘤部位。
欄位位置：82–82
fields.description_en:
Confirm whether the cancer originated in a paired organ or one side of the body. This field applies only to the primary tumor site.
Field position: 82–82
fields.purpose_zh: 側性可提供分期及癌病侵犯程度的資訊，並可確定原發侵犯的數目。
fields.guide_zh:
• 原發部位不明(C80.9)與非成對器官，其側性編碼為0；成對器官之編碼可以為1－5及9 (參看第一部份附加的資料) 。
• 若側位不詳，但是腫瘤是侷限於成對器官的某一側，編碼為3。
• 若確認原發側位別時，勿將對側轉移部位登錄為雙側侵犯。注意：若肺癌個案腫瘤雙側侵犯時，且無法確認原發側位別，則編碼為4。
• 原發部位為以下部位且為身體中線的腫瘤，編碼為5。 C700,C710-C714,C722-C725,C443, C444,C445。 若腫瘤非原發於以上部位時，則不可編碼為5。
• 非成對器官同時發現雙側侵犯時，則編碼為0。
• 非表列成對器官，若病歷記錄有描述側性則須登錄。範例：編碼：案例
0：甲狀腺癌個案病歷記載左右兩側侵犯。
3：病理報告記載個案有一個 2公分 carcinoma位於腎臟 upper pole處，其側位別編碼為3(因為只知道位置是在某ㄧ個腎，但是不知是左腎或右腎)。
9：個案診斷為肺癌，診斷依據為 sputum cytology，病歷上無其他任何與側位別相關資訊可提供。
5：個案肚臍正上方有一黑色素瘤，因皮膚為成對器官而腫瘤位於正中線腫瘤，故編碼為5。
1：右側口腔黏膜癌。
1：病歷記載為右側甲狀腺癌。
4：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師未明示或無法確認原發部位側性。
2：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師紀載原發部位為左側上葉(LUL)。
fields.purpose_en: Laterality provides information on stage and extent of disease and can determine the number of primary involvements.
fields.guide_en:
• For an unknown primary site (C80.9) and unpaired organs, the laterality is coded 0; for paired organs the code may be 1-5 and 9 (see the additional information in Part 1).
• If the laterality is unknown but the tumor is confined to one side of a paired organ, code 3.
• If the laterality of the primary is confirmed, do not record a contralateral metastatic site as bilateral involvement. Note: if a lung cancer case has bilateral tumor involvement and the laterality of the primary cannot be confirmed, code 4.
• If the primary site is one of the following sites and the tumor is on the midline of the body, code 5. C700, C710-C714, C722-C725, C443, C444, C445. If the tumor did not originate at the above sites, do not code 5.
• If bilateral involvement is found in an unpaired organ, code 0.
• For paired organs not listed, laterality must be recorded if the medical record describes it. Examples: Code: Case
0: The medical record of a thyroid cancer case documents involvement of both left and right sides.
3: The pathology report documents a 2 cm carcinoma at the upper pole of a kidney, so the laterality is coded 3 (because it is only known to be in one kidney, but not whether the left or right kidney).
9: The case was diagnosed with lung cancer, the basis of diagnosis was sputum cytology, and the medical record has no other information on laterality.
5: A melanoma is located just above the umbilicus of the case; because skin is a paired organ and the tumor is on the midline, it is coded 5.
1: Right oral mucosa cancer.
1: The medical record documents right thyroid cancer.
4: The case was diagnosed with lung cancer, the imaging report shows bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician did not state or it cannot be confirmed which side the primary site is on.
2: The case was diagnosed with lung cancer, the imaging report shows bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician documented the primary site as the left upper lobe (LUL).

fields.description_zh:
原發腫瘤細胞於顯微鏡下之結構。
欄位位置：83–86
fields.description_en:
Microscopic structure of the primary tumor cells.
Field position: 83–86
fields.purpose_zh: 作為分期及決定治療方針之根據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
• 依ICD-O-3第69－104頁Numeric Lists/Morphology，以及第105－218頁中Alphabetic Index的部分來進行histology編碼。同時請遵循ICD-O-3第20－40頁之編碼規則予以編碼。
• ICD-O-3之組織病理碼(M-code)第一個字母為M，之後接著四個數字，本欄位編碼只需數字部份，勿將M字填入。
• 對所有可申報之實質腫瘤(solid tumors)於登錄其histology之決定時，請採用SEER「Solid Tumor coding rules」中之編碼原則。這些規則乃適用於2018年1月1日(含)以後新診斷為癌症個案，2017年12月31日(含)以前新診斷之癌症個案請勿採用此規則。
• 若有病理報告時，須檢閱所有的病理報告。
• 血液惡性疾病個案之組織病理碼(M-code)依血液疾病編碼表登錄。
• 實質癌症(solid tumors)，依病理報告最終診斷(final pathologic diagnosis)記載之組織型態(histology)逕行編碼。附註：若病理報告依 CAP採條列式描述可採用，亦可參考病理報告中的評論(comment)的描述。例外： 若病理報告最終診斷為「未明示(Not Otherwise Specified, NOS)」，如carcinoma, NOS、melanoma, NOS、lymphoma, NOS、或malignant tumor, NOS，則須參考病理報告中的顯微鏡觀察或評論(comment)的描述，以確認更明確的編碼，例如：adenocarcinoma、amelanotic melanoma或 spindle cell sarcoma 等。
• cancer, NOS (8000)和carcinoma, NOS (8010)二者不可互換(參考ICD-O-3，第27頁)。若醫師僅描述個案患有carcinoma，則以未明示癌編碼之(8010)。
• 對於血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer【M9590-9993】)是否為單一或多重原發，請依下列原則編碼：
• 2010年1月1日(含)以後新診斷個案：應遵循SEER「Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual」最新公告版本與The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB) 之規則編碼。
• 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之histology逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。範例：編碼：標示 案例
8140：Adenocarcinoma 病理報告主診斷為 prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010)，其顯微鏡微觀(mircoscopic)敘述為 adenocarcinoma，則應編碼為 8140。
9680：Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 病歷最後診斷是 lymphoma，但有任何紀錄 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma的診斷時，應編碼為9680。
fields.purpose_en: Serves as the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
• Code histology according to the Numeric Lists/Morphology on pages 69-104 of ICD-O-3 and the Alphabetic Index on pages 105-218. Also follow the coding rules on pages 20-40 of ICD-O-3.
• The histopathology code (M-code) of ICD-O-3 begins with the letter M followed by four digits; this field requires only the numeric part, do not enter the letter M.
• When determining the histology of all reportable solid tumors, use the coding principles in the SEER “Solid Tumor coding rules”. These rules apply to cases newly diagnosed with cancer on or after January 1, 2018; do not apply these rules to cases newly diagnosed on or before December 31, 2017.
• When pathology reports are available, all pathology reports must be reviewed.
• The histopathology code (M-code) of hematologic malignancy cases is recorded according to the hematologic disease code table.
• For solid tumors, code directly according to the histology stated in the final pathologic diagnosis (final pathologic diagnosis) of the pathology report. Note: if the pathology report uses the CAP itemized format, it may be used, and the description in the comment (comment) of the pathology report may also be consulted. Exception: if the final diagnosis of the pathology report is “Not Otherwise Specified (NOS)”, such as carcinoma, NOS, melanoma, NOS, lymphoma, NOS, or malignant tumor, NOS, refer to the microscopic description or comment (comment) in the pathology report to confirm a more specific code, for example adenocarcinoma, amelanotic melanoma or spindle cell sarcoma.
• Cancer, NOS (8000) and carcinoma, NOS (8010) are not interchangeable (see ICD-O-3, page 27). If the physician describes the case only as having carcinoma, code it as carcinoma, NOS (8010).
• Whether hematopoietic and lymphoid cancer (Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer [M9590-9993]) is a single or multiple primary should be coded according to the following principles:
• For cases newly diagnosed on or after January 1, 2010: follow the latest published version of the SEER “Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual” and the rules of The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB).
• If the pathology specimen is taken from a metastatic site, because the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly with the histology of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code as 3. Example: Code: Label Case
8140: Adenocarcinoma. The main diagnosis of the pathology report is prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010), and its microscopic description is adenocarcinoma; it should be coded 8140.
9680: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The final diagnosis in the medical record is lymphoma, but if any record has a diagnosis of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, it should be coded 9680.

fields.description_zh:
記錄病理診斷中的性態碼。M-code中的第 5 碼即為性態碼。
欄位位置：87–87
fields.description_en:
Record the behavior code in the pathological diagnosis. The 5th digit of the M-code is the behavior code.
Field position: 87–87
fields.purpose_zh: 病理醫師常使用 benign(0)、borderline(1)、in situ(2)、malignant, primary site(3)、malignant, metastatic site(6)、或 malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site(9)來描述腫瘤的性態。其中性態碼為 2、3、6或9(若為6 或9者，須申報原發部位，且性態碼改為 3)的個案必須申報至癌症登記工作小組。
fields.guide_zh:
• 若原發腫瘤有惡性侵犯(malignant invasion)的部份，即使其侵犯程度或範圍非常有限(如：微侵犯microinvasion)，其性態碼一律編碼為3。
• 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之組織類型逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。
• Stage 0 的癌症一般性態碼為2，除了Paget’s disease(8540/3) of nipple/areola(C50.0)，以及侷限於lamina propria 的結直腸癌。
• 注意：Paget’s disease僅發生於乳頭、乳暈(C50.0)且乳房其他部位未發現任何腫瘤時，若病理報告明示Paget’s disease為in situ時，可編碼為8540/2。
• 原位癌個案非復發或疾病惡化情況下，發現有淋巴或遠端轉移，則性態碼編碼為3。例如：結腸切片病理報告診斷為 tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ，後續接受colectomy 未發現殘餘腫瘤，該手術同時執行 core liver biopsy 發現有adenocarcinoma，病歷記載肝臟腫瘤是結腸癌轉移，性態碼應從 2改為3。範例：編碼：案例
3：Intraductal carcinoma (8500/2) with focal areas of invasion.
1：Atypical meningioma (9539/1) invading bone of skull (the meninges, which line the skull, are capable of invading into the bone without being malignant; do not code as malignant unless it is specifically mentioned)
fields.purpose_en: Pathologists commonly describe tumor behavior as benign (0), borderline (1), in situ (2), malignant, primary site (3), malignant, metastatic site (6), or malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site (9). Cases with behavior code 2, 3, 6 or 9 (for 6 or 9, the primary site must be reported and the behavior code changed to 3) must be reported to the cancer registry working group.
fields.guide_en:
• If the primary tumor has a part with malignant invasion (malignant invasion), even if the extent of invasion is very limited (e.g. microinvasion), the behavior code is always 3.
• If the pathology specimen is taken from a metastatic site, because the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly with the histologic type of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code as 3.
• Stage 0 cancers generally have behavior code 2, except Paget’s disease (8540/3) of the nipple/areola (C50.0) and colorectal cancer confined to the lamina propria.
• Note: when Paget’s disease occurs only in the nipple or areola (C50.0) and no tumor is found elsewhere in the breast, if the pathology report states that Paget’s disease is in situ, it may be coded 8540/2.
• If a case with carcinoma in situ is found to have lymph node or distant metastasis in the absence of recurrence or disease progression, the behavior code is 3. For example: the colon biopsy pathology report was diagnosed as tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ; colectomy subsequently found no residual tumor, and a core liver biopsy performed at the same operation found adenocarcinoma, and the medical record stated that the liver tumor was a metastasis of colon cancer; the behavior code should be changed from 2 to 3. Example: Code: Case
3: Intraductal carcinoma (8500/2) with focal areas of invasion.
1: Atypical meningioma (9539/1) invading bone of skull (the meninges, which line the skull, are capable of invading into the bone without being malignant; do not code as malignant unless it is specifically mentioned)

fields.description_zh:
收錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化。分級/分化為腫瘤和正常組織的相似的程度。Well differentiated (Grade I)和正常組織最相似；Undifferentiated (Grade IV)和正常組織差異最大。
欄位位置：88–88
fields.description_en:
Record the grade/differentiation of the solid tumor before first treatment. Grade/differentiation is the degree of similarity between the tumor and normal tissue. Well differentiated (Grade I) is most similar to normal tissue; Undifferentiated (Grade IV) differs most from normal tissue.
Field position: 88–88
fields.purpose_zh: 與個案的預後有關。分級/分化可用以評估癌症嚴重程度；分級/分化及細胞型態對於許多癌症而言是重要的預後因子。分級/分化對於某些癌症更是判定臨床期別的依據之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 請依據AJCC第八版所建議的各癌別特殊分級/分化、一般分級/分化、字辭學摘錄；請參照手冊總論及附錄D。 本欄位僅摘錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化。 進行診斷性FNA、biopsy、needle core biopsy等組織病理學檢查並有描述分級/分化者，應記錄其臨床分級/分化。 臨床分級/分化請優先摘錄切片(biopsy、needle core biopsy)的病理報告；若未執行切片，則可參考細胞學報告。若有執行切片，但切片之病理報告無描述時，即使同時有細胞學檢查而且細胞學檢查報告有明示分級/分化，仍不採用細胞學檢查之資訊，分級/分化應編碼為9。 中樞神經系統應摘錄 WHO之分級/分化，請參照附錄 D。 實質腫瘤(solid tumor)之臨床分級/分化請依下列優先順序編碼︰ 各癌症部位特殊分級分化系統(site-special grade system)；請參考附錄D。 一般分級分化(generic grade)；請參考附錄D。 字辭學(terminology)；請參考總論。 分級/分化程度只能依原發部位經顯微鏡證實(病理學或細胞學)之報告結果編碼，勿採用轉移部位或復發的分級/分化程度，即使是轉移部位或復發的組織型態本身就含有分級/分化之意仍不採用。 原發部位已侵犯至鄰近器官，由鄰近器官取得病理組織，應視為原發腫瘤故可依據該病理報告描述之分級/分化結果逕行編碼。 若原發部位不明，應編碼為9 (分級/分化程度不詳)。 若病灶同時包括in situ和invasive時，應依其invasive部分的分級/分化程度編碼；但若其invasive部分之分級/分化程度不明，則編碼為9。 通常原位癌腫瘤是沒有分級的。若腫瘤是原位癌病灶(in situ lesions)之腫瘤組織有描述其分級/分化程度，可以此病灶的分級/分化程度來進行編碼。 若有超過一份以上的病理報告，且各報告之最終診斷的分級/分化不盡相同，則請依以下規則作為編碼之優先順序： 優先編碼AJCC第八版所建議之分級/分化(specific grading systems)，編碼為1-5。 若無AJCC第八版所建議之分級/分化，則以一般分級/分化(generic grade)之最高碼為主，編碼為A-D，L，H。 若癌症部位不適用於AJCC第八版，則請參考附錄D，分級/分化以最高碼為主。 若病理報告中主診斷(final diagnosis)未記載分化程度，則參考其顯微描述(Microscopic description)、補充說明(addendum)或評論(comment)的內容予以編碼。 若無病理組織報告，其分級/分化程度可參考磁振造影術(MRI)或正子造影術(PET)等報告上之描述進行編碼。 血液腫瘤(M-code 9590-9993)之分級/分化，自2018診斷年起一律編碼為8(不適用)；僅Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6)且組織型態為follicular lymphoma (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3)，需編碼分級/分化，請參考Grade 19及AJCC第八版第71章。 對於dysplasia，請勿編碼其分級程度，例如High grade dysplasia應編碼為X。 卵 巢 borderline tumor (Low malignant potential) 合 併 microinvasive carcinoma 或 / 與intraepithelial carcinoma，本欄位應編碼為X。 闌尾(Appendix)組織型態為 Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN)或 High grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN)，應分別編碼為 L或H。 編碼9(不詳)： 分化/分級不明或病歷未記載。 首次治療前未有臨床分級/分化。 術後才診斷為癌症。 當病歷中只有一個分級/分化，且無法區分是臨床或是病理時，應編碼於臨床分級/分化中，病理分級/分化應編碼9 (不詳)。範例：編碼：案例
1：Buccal mucosa cancer 個案接受切片檢查，病理切片報告描述為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，後續接受 wide excision，病理報告描述為 squamous cell carcinoma in situ。因切片檢查為診斷性處置，不可視為切除性手術。
3：食道癌個案，其病理切片報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated，經手術治療切除腫瘤，其手術病理報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，
9：乳癌個案手術前病理切片報告未描述分級/分化，CSRT 後切除腫瘤，病理報告描述分級/分化為 Grade 2。
9：個案病理切片報告為 Sclerosing liposarcoma （M-code：8851/3），未描述分級/分化。
3：個案MRI報告描述corpus striatum tumor 且診斷為Anaplastic oligodendroglioma。病歷記錄未描述 WHO grade，參考附錄 D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1 為WHO Grade III，則可編碼為 3。
9：個案病理切片報告為 C4-5，biopsy of intramedullary tumor，組織型態為Ependymoma,with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive，病理報告未描述 WHO grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1仍無法判定 WHO Grade，則應編碼為9。
2：個案MRI報告描述 Diffuse astrocytoma，low grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1為 WHO Grade II，則可編碼為 2。編碼：案例
L：個案Brain MRI報告描述Glioma，low grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20，編碼為 L。
9：肺癌個案同時接受 RUL, fine-needle aspiration 及 CT-guide biopsy。Fine-needle aspiration 病理報告描述 Poorly differentiated carcinoma；而CT-guide biopsy 病理報告結果為Adenocarcinoma，未描述分級/分化，不應摘錄細胞學檢查之分級/分化。
H：個案由影像診斷為 Renal pelvis cancer ，並接受 ureteroscope biopsy，切片病理報告為Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade；之後執行nephroureterectomy，手術後的病理報告描述為 no residual tumor，臨床及病理分級/分化皆編碼為 H。
fields.purpose_en: Related to the prognosis of the case. Grade/differentiation can be used to assess the severity of cancer; grade/differentiation and cell type are important prognostic factors for many cancers. For some cancers, grade/differentiation is also one of the bases for determining clinical stage.
fields.guide_en:
Abstract according to the cancer-site-specific grade/differentiation, generic grade/differentiation and terminology recommended by AJCC 8th edition; see the general introduction of the manual and Appendix D. This field abstracts only the grade/differentiation of the solid tumor before first treatment. If histopathologic examinations such as diagnostic FNA, biopsy or needle core biopsy were performed and describe grade/differentiation, record the clinical grade/differentiation. For clinical grade/differentiation, abstract preferentially from the pathology report of a biopsy (biopsy, needle core biopsy); if no biopsy was performed, the cytology report may be consulted. If a biopsy was performed but its pathology report does not describe it, even if cytology was also performed and its report states grade/differentiation, do not use the cytology information, and grade/differentiation should be coded 9. For the central nervous system, abstract the WHO grade/differentiation; see Appendix D. Code the clinical grade/differentiation of solid tumors in the following order of priority: site-specific grade system (see Appendix D); generic grade (see Appendix D); terminology (see the general introduction). Grade/differentiation may be coded only from microscopically confirmed (pathologic or cytologic) reports of the primary site; do not use the grade/differentiation of a metastatic site or recurrence, even if the histology of the metastatic site or recurrence itself implies grade/differentiation. If the primary site has invaded an adjacent organ and pathologic tissue is obtained from the adjacent organ, it should be regarded as the primary tumor, so the grade/differentiation described in that pathology report may be coded directly. If the primary site is unknown, code 9 (grade/differentiation unknown). If a lesion contains both in situ and invasive components, code the grade/differentiation of the invasive component; if the grade/differentiation of the invasive component is unknown, code 9. In situ tumors are usually not graded. If the tumor tissue of an in situ lesion has a described grade/differentiation, the grade/differentiation of that lesion may be coded. If there is more than one pathology report and the final diagnoses differ in grade/differentiation, use the following order of priority for coding: first code the grade/differentiation recommended by AJCC 8th edition (specific grading systems), coded 1-5. If AJCC 8th edition has no recommended grade/differentiation, use the highest code of the generic grade, coded A-D, L, H. If the cancer site is not covered by AJCC 8th edition, see Appendix D and use the highest code of grade/differentiation. If the final diagnosis of the pathology report does not record differentiation, code from the microscopic description, addendum or comment. If there is no pathology report, grade/differentiation may be coded from the description in reports such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or positron emission tomography (PET). For hematologic neoplasms (M-code 9590-9993), grade/differentiation is always coded 8 (not applicable) from diagnosis year 2018; only for lymphoma of the ocular adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6) with histology follicular lymphoma (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3) must grade/differentiation be coded; see Grade 19 and AJCC 8th edition Chapter 71. For dysplasia, do not code the grade, e.g. high grade dysplasia should be coded X. For ovarian borderline tumor (low malignant potential) with microinvasive carcinoma and/or intraepithelial carcinoma, code this field X. For appendix with histology low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) or high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), code L or H respectively. Code 9 (unknown): grade/differentiation unknown or not recorded in the medical record; no clinical grade/differentiation before first treatment; cancer diagnosed only after surgery. When the medical record has only one grade/differentiation and it cannot be determined whether it is clinical or pathologic, code it as clinical grade/differentiation and code pathologic grade/differentiation as 9 (unknown). Examples: Code: Case
1: A buccal mucosa cancer case underwent biopsy, and the pathology report described squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated; the case then underwent wide excision, and the pathology report described squamous cell carcinoma in situ. Because biopsy is a diagnostic procedure, it cannot be regarded as resection surgery.
3: An esophageal cancer case whose biopsy pathology report was squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated, underwent surgical tumor resection, and the surgical pathology report was squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated.
9: A breast cancer case's pre-operative biopsy pathology report did not describe grade/differentiation; after CSRT the tumor was resected, and the pathology report described grade/differentiation as Grade 2.
9: The case's biopsy pathology report was sclerosing liposarcoma (M-code: 8851/3), with no description of grade/differentiation.
3: The case's MRI report described a corpus striatum tumor and diagnosed anaplastic oligodendroglioma. The medical record did not describe the WHO grade; referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and Table 1, this corresponds to WHO Grade III, so it may be coded 3.
9: The case's biopsy pathology report was C4-5, biopsy of intramedullary tumor, histology ependymoma with molecular testing RELA fusion-positive, and the pathology report did not describe the WHO grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and Table 1, the WHO grade still cannot be determined, so code 9.
2: The case's MRI report described diffuse astrocytoma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and Table 1, this corresponds to WHO Grade II, so it may be coded 2. Code: Case
L: The case's brain MRI report described glioma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D, code L.
9: A lung cancer case underwent both RUL fine-needle aspiration and CT-guided biopsy. The fine-needle aspiration pathology report described poorly differentiated carcinoma, while the CT-guided biopsy pathology report was adenocarcinoma with no description of grade/differentiation; the grade/differentiation from the cytologic examination should not be abstracted.
H: The case was diagnosed by imaging as renal pelvis cancer and underwent ureteroscope biopsy, with biopsy pathology report papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade; nephroureterectomy was then performed and the post-operative pathology report described no residual tumor; clinical and pathologic grade/differentiation are both coded H.

欄位位置：89–89
fields.description_en:
Record the grade/differentiation of the solid tumor after primary site surgery. Grade/differentiation is the degree of similarity between the tumor and normal tissue. Well differentiated (Grade I) is most similar to normal tissue; Undifferentiated (Grade IV) differs most from normal tissue.
Field position: 89–89

If the tumor tissue of an in situ lesion has a described grade/differentiation, that grade/differentiation of the lesion may be used for coding.• If there is more than one pathology report and the grades/differentiation in their final diagnoses differ, use the following order of priority for coding:• Code first the grade/differentiation recommended by the AJCC 8th edition (specific grading systems), coded 1-5.• For Grades 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 13, 16, 19 and 22 in Appendix D, use mainly the pathology report of the surgical resection with the largest tumor volume at the primary site.• If the AJCC 8th edition does not recommend a grade/differentiation, use mainly the highest code of the generic grade, coded A-D, L, H.• If the cancer site is not covered by the AJCC 8th edition, refer to Appendix D and use mainly the highest grade/differentiation code.• If the final diagnosis of the pathology report does not state the degree of differentiation, refer to the microscopic description, addendum or comment for coding.• For hematologic neoplasms (M-code 9590-9993), grade/differentiation is always coded 8 (not applicable) from 2018; only for Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6) with follicular lymphoma histology (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3) must grade/differentiation be coded; see Grade 19 and Chapter 71 of the AJCC 8th edition.• For dysplasia, do not code a grade; high grade dysplasia should be coded X.• For ovarian borderline tumor (low malignant potential) with microinvasive carcinoma and/or intraepithelial carcinoma, code X in this field.• For appendix histology of low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) or high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), code L or H, respectively.• Code 9 (unknown):• Differentiation/grade unknown or not documented in the medical record.• No surgery at the primary site.• Neoadjuvant therapy was given before surgery, and the post-operative pathology report describes no residual tumor.• When the medical record contains only one grade/differentiation and it cannot be distinguished as clinical or pathologic, code it in the clinical grade/differentiation and code the pathologic grade/differentiation as 9 (unknown).Examples: Code: Case

fields.purpose_zh: 作為統計癌症經顯微鏡檢確認之比例。完整的癌症發生率統計應包括臨床及病理確診的個案。
fields.guide_zh:
實質腫瘤(solid tumor)編碼指引(所有腫瘤，組織型態為 M9590-9993除外)：
• 請依序從最精確的histologic confirmation (編碼1)到最不精確的unknown (編碼9)。編碼1是癌症最精確的確診方法，只要個案有接受編碼1的方式，則不管個案是否有接受其他形式的檢查，一律編碼為1。
• 個案於病程中任何時間只要有接受了更精確的癌症確診方式，則修改為數字較小的編碼。
• 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為1： Biopsy、frozen section、surgery、autopsy或D&C等組織標本。 骨髓標本(aspiration or biopsy)。
• 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為2： 細胞學檢查，可包括sputum smears、bronchial brushings、bronchial washings、prostatic secretions、breast secretions、gastric fluid、spinal fluid、peritoneal fluid、pleural fluid、urinary sediment、cervical smears、vaginal smears。例如：因子宮頸抹片檢查結果偽陽性機率偏高，因此所有子宮頸癌個案「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」皆以最早的 Histology 採檢日期為主；若只有 Pap smear 檢查結果為CIN3或以上，而Histology結果呈陰性，則不需申報，除非臨床醫師仍診斷為子宮頸癌時，則以其 Pap smear來編碼，「癌症確診方式」編碼為 2。 濃縮之spinal、pleural、或peritoneal fluid的石蠟塊(Paraffin block)標本。
• 當醫師臨床診斷為癌症時，如當時是依據某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢查/腫瘤標記之臨床確診時，可編碼為5。例如︰攝護腺癌個案的檢查結果只有 PSA值升高，而臨床醫師亦依據此 PSA值而診斷為癌症。例外：肝癌的 alpha-fetoprotein不可視為癌症確診方式。
• 手術探查之外科醫師手術報告，或經由colonoscopy、mediastinoscopy、或 peritoneoscopy等內視鏡檢查，同時未做組織檢體檢查者，編碼為6。淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患編碼指引 (組織型態為 M9590-9993) 淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患之確診方式編碼並無優先順序。多數明確的組織型態多由免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷。「The Hematopoietic Database(DB)」提供腫瘤型態更明確的診斷資訊。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為1： Biopsy、frozen section、surgery、autopsy或bone marrow(aspiration or biopsy)等組織標本。 僅適用於leukemia：經hematologic findings確診者，包括周邊血液抹片(peripheral blood smears)、全血球計數(CBC)及白血球計數(WBC)；若僅是利用骨髓或血液執行免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷，編碼不應為1。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為2： 細胞學檢查，可包括spinal fluid、peritoneal fluid、pleural fluid、urinary sediment、cervical smears、vaginal smears及濃縮之spinal、pleural、或peritoneal fluid的石蠟塊(Paraffin block)標本。這些方法極少用於診斷血液腫瘤或淋巴腫瘤。 當組織學診斷為癌症時，且免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷亦為陽性，編碼為3。 當醫師臨床診斷為癌症時，是依據某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢查/腫瘤標記(包含免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)同時/或基因(genetic)檢測)，但無組織學確診時，編碼為5。例如：Multiple myeloma 或Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia 之不正常電泳高峰(electrophoretic spike)。 若經由外科醫師手術探查之手術報告、或經由內視鏡檢查報告或屍體直接查看診斷為癌症，未做組織或細胞學檢查者，編碼為6。 當醫師僅以臨床診斷為癌症，無法編碼6或7時，則編碼為8。許多淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患，醫師的臨床診斷基於檢查檢驗報告與個案的臨床表現，以排除診斷的方式來確立診斷。
fields.purpose_en: Used to calculate the proportion of cancers confirmed by microscopic examination. Complete cancer incidence statistics should include clinically and pathologically confirmed cases.
fields.guide_en:
Coding guide for solid tumors (solid tumor) (all tumors except histology M9590-9993):
• Go in order from the most precise, histologic confirmation (code 1), to the least precise, unknown (code 9). Code 1 is the most precise method of confirming cancer; whenever the patient has received a method coded 1, code 1 regardless of whether the patient received other forms of examination.
• If at any time during the course of disease the patient receives a more precise method of confirming cancer, change to the lower-numbered code.
• The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 1: • Tissue specimens from biopsy, frozen section, surgery, autopsy or D&C. • Bone marrow specimens (aspiration or biopsy).
• The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 2: • Cytologic examination, which may include sputum smears, bronchial brushings, bronchial washings, prostatic secretions, breast secretions, gastric fluid, spinal fluid, peritoneal fluid, pleural fluid, urinary sediment, cervical smears and vaginal smears. For example: because the false-positive rate of cervical (Pap) smear results is high, for all cervical cancer cases the "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest histology sampling date; if only the Pap smear result is CIN3 or above and the histology result is negative, no report is needed, unless the clinician still diagnoses cervical cancer, in which case code according to the Pap smear, and the "Method of cancer confirmation" is coded 2. • Paraffin block specimens of concentrated spinal, pleural or peritoneal fluid.
• When the physician makes a clinical diagnosis of cancer, if it was a clinical confirmation based on certain laboratory tests/tumor markers used for the clinical diagnosis of specific cancers, code 5. For example: a prostate cancer patient whose only finding is an elevated PSA, and the clinician also diagnosed cancer based on this PSA value. Exception: alpha-fetoprotein for liver cancer must not be regarded as a means of confirming cancer.
• Code 6 if the diagnosis is from the surgeon's operative report of surgical exploration, or from endoscopy such as colonoscopy, mediastinoscopy or peritoneoscopy, with no tissue specimen examined. Coding guide for lymphoma, leukemia and other hematologic neoplastic diseases (histology M9590-9993) • There is no order of priority among the confirmation method codes for lymphoma, leukemia and other hematologic neoplastic diseases. Most definitive histologies are diagnosed by immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing. "The Hematopoietic Database (DB)" provides diagnostic information for more definitive tumor types. • The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 1: • Tissue specimens from biopsy, frozen section, surgery, autopsy or bone marrow (aspiration or biopsy). • Applicable to leukemia only: confirmed by hematologic findings, including peripheral blood smears, complete blood count (CBC) and white blood cell count (WBC); if the diagnosis is made only by immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing on bone marrow or blood, the code should not be 1. • The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 2: • Cytologic examination, which may include spinal fluid, peritoneal fluid, pleural fluid, urinary sediment, cervical smears, vaginal smears, and paraffin block specimens of concentrated spinal, pleural or peritoneal fluid. These methods are rarely used to diagnose hematologic or lymphoid neoplasms. • When the histologic diagnosis is cancer and the immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing diagnosis is also positive, code 3. • When the physician makes a clinical diagnosis of cancer based on certain laboratory tests/tumor markers used for the clinical diagnosis of specific cancers (including immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing), without histologic confirmation, code 5. For example: the abnormal electrophoretic spike (electrophoretic spike) of multiple myeloma or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia. • If cancer is diagnosed from the surgeon's operative report of surgical exploration, from an endoscopy report, or by direct inspection at autopsy, without tissue or cytologic examination, code 6. • When the physician makes only a clinical diagnosis of cancer and neither 6 nor 7 can be coded, code 8. For many lymphomas, leukemias and other hematologic neoplastic diseases, the physician's clinical diagnosis is based on examination and laboratory reports and the patient's clinical presentation, and the diagnosis is established by exclusion.

fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄採取標本的日期，而非病理報告完成日期。
• 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」以最早確定診斷日期為主，而病理組織型態則以較詳細之病理報告為主。
• 若細胞學檢查(cytology)報告中使用含糊不清的詞彙，例如”suspicious for malignancy”，不可編碼為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期。
• 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」以病理上的診斷為依據，包括Histology及Cytology。若個案Histology及Cytology採檢的日期不同，則以最早採檢的日期為主。例外 1：因子宮頸抹片檢查結果偽陽性機率偏高，因此所有子宮頸癌個案「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」皆以最早的 Histology採檢日期為主；若只有 Pap smear檢查結果為CIN3或以上，而Histology結果呈陰性，則不需申報；除非臨床醫師仍診斷為子宮頸癌時，則以其 Pap smear採檢日期來編碼。例外 2：白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)個案，全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常，醫師使用含糊不清字彙診斷癌症，則該採檢日不得為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期。
• 個案經診斷為白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)者，若有下列任一情況時，以最早採檢日期為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期： 單次全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常。 多份全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常，且醫師確定診斷時明示採用某份異常報告；若醫師未明示採用某份異常報告，則以癌症確診後最近一份異常報告為主。 白血病個案若周邊血液(peripheral blood) blast≧20%，雖然醫師於病歷描述為 rule out leukemia，仍可以視為確診。(此適用於 2023診斷年之前個案) 經骨髓或其他組織切片檢查證實。注意1：執行CBC 或WBC 檢查結果須為異常，才可視為組織病理確診。注意2：CBC 或 WBC異常判定標準，請諮詢醫師或參考院內共識；若未能諮詢到醫師，則視報告結果無異常，癌登人員不需自行判斷。
• 許多淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患，醫師的臨床診斷依據檢查檢驗報告與個案的臨床表徵，且以排除其他癌症的方式來確立診斷，故「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」應編碼為00000000。
• 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」盡量將年月日填寫完整，若無法填寫完整，請盡量推算至月份。範例：編碼：案例
