fields.purpose_en: Understand the difference between the initial diagnosis date and the date first confirmed by microscopic examination; can also be used to calculate the time interval to completion of staging or start of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the date the specimen was collected, not the date the pathology report was completed.
• "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest date of definitive diagnosis, whereas the histology is based on the more detailed pathology report.
• If a cytology report uses vague wording such as "suspicious for malignancy", it must not be coded as the date of first microscopic confirmation.
• "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the pathologic diagnosis, including histology and cytology. If the histology and cytology specimens were collected on different dates, use the earliest collection date. Exception 1: Because the false-positive rate of cervical smear results is high, for all cervical cancer cases the "date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest histology collection date; if only the Pap smear result is CIN3 or above and the histology result is negative, the case need not be reported, unless the clinician still diagnoses cervical cancer, in which case code the Pap smear collection date. Exception 2: For leukemia or other hematologic neoplasm cases (excluding lymphoma) in which the complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) report is abnormal and the physician uses vague wording to diagnose cancer, that collection date must not be the date of first microscopic confirmation.
• For cases diagnosed as leukemia or other hematologic neoplasms (excluding lymphoma), in any of the following situations the earliest collection date is the date of first microscopic confirmation:• A single abnormal CBC or WBC report.• Multiple abnormal CBC or WBC reports, where the physician explicitly cites one abnormal report when confirming the diagnosis; if the physician does not explicitly cite a particular abnormal report, use the abnormal report closest to the confirmed cancer diagnosis.• For leukemia cases with blasts ≧20% in peripheral blood, the diagnosis may be regarded as confirmed even if the physician describes it in the medical record as rule out leukemia. (This applies to cases diagnosed before 2023.)• Confirmed by bone marrow or other tissue biopsy. Note 1: The CBC or WBC result must be abnormal to be regarded as histopathologic confirmation. Note 2: For the criteria for an abnormal CBC or WBC, consult a physician or refer to the hospital's consensus; if no physician can be consulted, treat the report result as not abnormal; registrars need not judge it themselves.
• For many lymphomas, leukemias and other hematologic neoplasms, the physician's clinical diagnosis is based on examination and laboratory reports and the patient's clinical presentation, and the diagnosis is established by excluding other cancers, so the "date of first microscopic confirmation" should be coded 00000000.
• Fill in the "date of first microscopic confirmation" as completely as possible with year, month and day; if it cannot be completed, estimate at least to the month. Examples: Code: Case
20050320: A mammogram on 12 March ROC year 94 (2005) showed cancer (compatible with carcinoma) in the upper-outer quadrant of the patient's right breast. On 20 March ROC year 94 (2005), the patient underwent excisional breast biopsy, confirming infiltrating ductal carcinoma.
20030615: The physician recorded that on a physical examination on 12 May ROC year 92 (2003) a nodule was found in the patient's prostate and cancer was suspected. On 15 June ROC year 92 (2003), the histology of an ultrasound-guided needle biopsy of the prostate confirmed adenocarcinoma.
20040131: The patient's pathology report at Hospital A was Carcinoma (2004/1/31), and at the reporting hospital it was Sarcomatoid carcinoma (2004/2/10); code 20040131.
20060612: On 12 June ROC year 95 (2006) a sputum specimen confirmed Non-small cell carcinoma; on 26 June ROC year 95 (2006) bronchoscopy with tissue biopsy showed large cell carcinoma.
20110901: The patient had a CBC/WBC test on 1 September ROC year 100 (2011), and on 3 September the physician diagnosed leukemia based on the cytology report. On 4 September ROC year 100 (2011), bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110904: The patient had a CBC/WBC test on 1 September ROC year 100 (2011), and on 3 September the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. On 4 September ROC year 100 (2011), bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
00000000: The patient had a CBC/WBC test on 1 September ROC year 100 (2011), and on 3 September the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. Chemotherapy began on 4 September ROC year 100 (2011).
20110905: The patient had a CBC/WBC test on 1 September ROC year 100 (2011), and the report did not describe an abnormality. A repeat CBC/WBC blood test on 5 September was abnormal, and the physician cited this abnormal report to record leukemia; bone marrow biopsy on 7 September then confirmed AML.
20121112: On 12 November ROC year 101 (2012), the cervical biopsy histopathology report was HSIL (moderate to severe dysplasia or CIN2-CIN3). Not reported: On 12 November ROC year 101 (2012), the cervical biopsy pathology report was HSIL (moderate dysplasia or CIN2). Not reported: On 12 November ROC year 101 (2012), the cervical smear report was HSIL, and on 6 December ROC year 101 (2012) the conization pathology report was CIN2.
20121112: On 12 November ROC year 101 (2012), the cervical biopsy histopathology report described only HSIL; on 6 December ROC year 101 (2012) the conization pathology report was CIN2; after consulting the physician it was confirmed that the HSIL report meant CIN2-3.
20121112: On 12 November ROC year 101 (2012), the cervical biopsy pathology report was HSIL, and on 6 December ROC year 101 (2012) the conization pathology report was CIN3; after consulting the physician it was confirmed that the HSIL report meant CIN2-3.First course of treatment

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院，最早針對癌症進行手術的日期。
欄位位置：99–106
fields.description_en:
Record the date of the earliest cancer-directed surgery at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 99–106
fields.purpose_zh: 可進行多種治療模式的排序或是評估多種治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄在申報醫院首次進行手術相關欄位的最早日期，這些手術相關欄位的日期，包括：「原發部位手術方式」、「區域淋巴結手術範圍」或「其他部位手術方式」等執行手術的日期。例外 1：僅執行區域淋巴結診斷性切片(incisional/excisional biposy, core biopsy)或抽吸(aspiration)取樣者，其日期不可編碼於「首次手術日期」欄位。例外 2：若攝護腺癌個案於申報醫院僅接受 TURP或 Laser TURP，「首次手術日期」應編碼為 00000000；但必須於「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」編碼 89。注意：若個案因 BPH接受 TURP後確診為攝護腺癌，後續接受 HIFU治療；則「首次手術日期」應編碼執行 HIFU的日期，而「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」應編碼為 90。例外 3：若個案僅執行哨兵淋巴結取樣(sentinel lymph node sampling；SLNB)或哨兵淋巴結取樣合併區域淋巴結手術，所執行之哨兵淋巴結取樣日期皆不可編碼於「首次手術日期」欄位。例外 4：若膀胱癌個案執行 TURBT for biopsy、for tissue proof 或 for diagnosis時，視為診斷性處置，其日期不可編碼於「首次手術日期」欄位。範例：編碼：案例
20090215：乳癌個案在民國 98年2月 15日做lumpectomy 確診後，於民國98年 2月25日執行 Total mastectomy 切除左側乳房。
20090420：個案在民國 98 年 4 月 15 日接受子宮內膜切片檢查，病理報告確診為子宮內膜癌後，於民國 98年4月 20日接受ATH手術並切除兩側輸卵管及卵巢。
00000000：個案年紀 80歲因BPH接受 TURP 後確診為攝護腺癌(術式編碼89)，同時伴有下背痛因此接受骨骼描述發現有骨轉移，醫師於民國 105年5月20 日治療規劃為 watchful waiting，後續病患於外院接受定期追踨。
fields.purpose_en: Allows ordering of multiple treatment modalities and evaluation of the time intervals between treatments.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the earliest date of the first surgery-related fields at the reporting hospital; the dates of these surgery-related fields include the dates of the surgery in "Primary site surgical procedure", "Regional lymph node surgery scope" or "Surgical procedure of other sites". Exception 1: If only a diagnostic biopsy of regional lymph nodes (incisional/excisional biopsy, core biopsy) or aspiration sampling was performed, its date must not be coded in the "Date of first surgery" field. Exception 2: If a patient with prostate cancer received only TURP or Laser TURP at the reporting hospital, "Date of first surgery" should be coded 00000000, but "Reporting hospital primary site surgical procedure" must be coded 89. Note: if a patient is diagnosed with prostate cancer after TURP for BPH and subsequently receives HIFU, "Date of first surgery" should be coded as the date HIFU was performed, and "Reporting hospital primary site surgical procedure" should be coded 90. Exception 3: If a patient has only sentinel lymph node sampling (SLNB) or sentinel lymph node sampling combined with regional lymph node surgery, the date of sentinel lymph node sampling must not be coded in the "Date of first surgery" field. Exception 4: If a patient with bladder cancer undergoes TURBT for biopsy, for tissue proof or for diagnosis, it is regarded as a diagnostic procedure and its date must not be coded in the "Date of first surgery" field. Examples: Code: Case
20090215: A patient with breast cancer was confirmed after lumpectomy on 15 February ROC year 98 (2009), and underwent total mastectomy of the left breast on 25 February ROC year 98 (2009).
20090420: A patient underwent endometrial biopsy on 15 April ROC year 98 (2009), and after the pathology report confirmed endometrial cancer, underwent ATH with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy on 20 April ROC year 98 (2009).
00000000: An 80-year-old patient was diagnosed with prostate cancer after TURP for BPH (procedure code 89), and also had low back pain, for which a bone scan found bone metastasis; on 20 May ROC year 105 (2016) the physician's treatment plan was watchful waiting, and the patient was subsequently followed regularly at another facility.

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院原發部位手術方式
fields.name_en: Surgical Procedure of Primary Site at this Facility
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院對原發部位所進行的手術方式。
欄位位置：107–108
fields.description_en:
Record the surgical procedure performed on the primary site at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 107–108
fields.purpose_zh: 用來比較不同治療方式的效果。
fields.guide_zh:
• 肝癌個案若不是以手術切除方式來執行局部腫瘤破壞治療方式者，如接受經導管肝動脈血管栓塞術(Transcatheter Arterial Embolization; TAE)、經皮酒精注射療法(Percutaneous Ethanol Injection Therapy; PEIT)或經皮醋酸注射療法(Percutaneous Acetic Acid Injection Therapy; PAIT)、射頻燒灼術(Heat-Radio-Frequency Ablation; RFA)等兩種以上治療，則編碼80。
• 肝癌個案若有手術加上任一種局部腫瘤破壞治療，則編碼為85~87；如個案若有手術加上任兩種局部腫瘤破壞治療，則編碼為81。
• 攝護腺癌個案接受HIFU及TURP治療，則「首次手術日期」應編碼執行HIFU的日期，而「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」應編碼為90。
• 膀胱癌個案接受TURBT，若僅為診斷性處置，則「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」應編碼為00。
• 若執行之手術是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。
fields.purpose_en: Used to compare the effects of different treatment modalities.
fields.guide_en:
• For a liver cancer case that did not undergo surgical resection but received local tumor destruction treatment, such as two or more treatments among transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE), percutaneous ethanol injection therapy (PEIT) or percutaneous acetic acid injection therapy (PAIT), and radiofrequency ablation (RFA), code 80.
• If a liver cancer case had surgery plus any one type of local tumor destruction treatment, code 85-87; if the case had surgery plus any two types of local tumor destruction treatment, code 81.
• For a prostate cancer case that received HIFU and TURP, the "Date of first surgery" should be coded as the date HIFU was performed, and the "Reporting hospital primary site surgical procedure" should be coded 90.
• For a bladder cancer case that received TURBT, if it was only a diagnostic procedure, the "Reporting hospital primary site surgical procedure" should be coded 00.
• If the surgery performed was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the patient more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的開始日期。
欄位位置：109–116
fields.description_en:
Record the start date of radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 109–116
fields.purpose_zh: 在併用多重治療模式中，病理期別是很多癌症的重要預後因素，也是決定後續輔助治療與否的依據，因此記錄個別治療方式之時間順序及實際間隔，是非常重要的；手術前的放射治療可能會改變期別，並影響其應用於分析評估之使用方式。
fields.guide_zh:
• 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。
• 如果是多重放射治療模式(例如子宮頸癌的合併體外放射治療及體內近距放療)，「放射治療開始日期」必須記載的是整個多重放射治療模式的開始日期。
• 治療日期通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。範例：編碼：案例
20031215：個案於民國 92年12月15 日接受體外放射治療。
20031012：惡性腦瘤個案於民國 92年 10月12日接受加馬刀立體型放射手術。
20031012：非小細胞肺癌個案因腦轉移於 2003/10/12 做立體定位加馬刀放射手術，隨後於2003/12/15 至2003/12/30 接受12次總劑量30Gy 的全腦放射治療。
20031121：非小細胞肺癌個案於2003/11/21至2003/12/10接受12次總劑量30Gy的全腦放射治療，再於 2003/12/12 對腦轉移做立體定位加馬刀放射手術。
20060401：個案罹患巨大(bulky)之2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11接受28次總劑量50.4Gy的全骨盆2D Box放射治療，並於總劑量達到39.6Gy時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再於Point A 處給予6 次各 500cGy 之銥-192(Ir-192)的空腔內高劑量率近距放射治療(2006/06/01及 2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15 及 2006/06/16 給予 500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 之化學藥物治療。
20060401：個案罹患巨大之 2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/04/30 先接受總劑量39.6Gy的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療；接著再於Point A 給予 6次各500cGy 銥-192 的腔內高劑量率近距放射治療(2006/05/05 及 2006/05/07 給予500cGy x3，再於2006/05/19及2006/05/20給予500cGy x3)；最後於2006/06/01至 2006/06/08 再接受另外 6 次總劑量達 10.8Gy 的子宮旁結締組織(parametrial)之放射治療。體外放射治療期間並同時給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 藥物治療。
fields.purpose_en: In combined multimodality treatment, pathological stage is an important prognostic factor for many cancers and is the basis for deciding whether to give subsequent adjuvant treatment, so it is very important to record the time sequence and actual intervals of the individual treatment modalities; preoperative radiation therapy may change the stage and affect how it is used in analysis and evaluation.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital commissioned another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the other facility's radiotherapy data must be integrated and reported in full.
• If there is a multiple radiotherapy modality (for example, combined external beam radiotherapy and internal brachytherapy for cervical cancer), the "Radiotherapy start date" must be the start date of the entire multiple-modality radiotherapy.
• The treatment date is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. Examples: Code: Case
20031215: The patient received external beam radiotherapy on 15 December ROC year 92 (2003).
20031012: A patient with a malignant brain tumor received Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery on 12 October ROC year 92 (2003).
20031012: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer received stereotactic Gamma Knife radiosurgery for brain metastasis on 2003/10/12, followed from 2003/12/15 to 2003/12/30 by whole-brain radiotherapy of 30 Gy in 12 fractions.
20031121: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer received whole-brain radiotherapy of 30 Gy in 12 fractions from 2003/11/21 to 2003/12/10, then stereotactic Gamma Knife radiosurgery for brain metastasis on 2003/12/12.
20060401: A patient with bulky stage 2B squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy of 50.4 Gy in 28 fractions, with central block after 39.6 Gy. This was followed by 6 fractions of 500 cGy each of intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 (Ir-192) brachytherapy to Point A (500 cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, then 500 cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100 mg chemotherapy were given concurrently during external beam radiotherapy.
20060401: A patient with bulky stage 2B squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix first received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/30, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy with a total dose of 39.6 Gy; this was followed by 6 fractions of 500 cGy each of intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A (500 cGy x3 on 2006/05/05 and 2006/05/07, then 500 cGy x3 on 2006/05/19 and 2006/05/20); finally, from 2006/06/01 to 2006/06/08, the patient received a further 6 fractions of parametrial radiotherapy with a total dose of 10.8 Gy. Two courses of Cisplatin 100 mg were given concurrently during external beam radiotherapy.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的相關情形。
欄位位置：117–117
fields.description_en:
Record the radiation therapy given in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 117–117
fields.purpose_zh: 本欄位資料對於瞭解放射治療的轉介形式和評估對個案進行放射治療的場所其品質和結果，可以提供相當有用的資訊。
fields.guide_zh:
• 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。
• 若於申報醫院執行之放射治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。
fields.purpose_en: Data in this field provide quite useful information for understanding the referral pattern of radiotherapy and for evaluating the quality and outcomes of the setting where the case received radiotherapy.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital commissions another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data of the other facility must be integrated and reported completely.
• If the radiotherapy given at the reporting hospital is to control symptoms to prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it should also be recorded in the “Palliative care at the reporting hospital” field.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院首次療程中，所給予化學治療相關情形。化學治療包括多種抗癌藥物，可干擾癌細胞中 DNA的合成和分裂。
欄位位置：118–119
fields.description_en:
Record the chemotherapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. Chemotherapy includes many anticancer drugs that can interfere with DNA synthesis and division in cancer cells.
Field position: 118–119
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估首次療程的化學治療。
fields.guide_zh:
• 僅記載申報醫院在首次療程中所給予個案化學治療的相關情形。不包括外院在首次療程中所給予個案的化學治療。
• 記錄首次療程中，所給予化學治療之相關情形，包括：全身性化學治療、局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)、其他局部性化學治療及臨床試驗化學治療。
• 針對轉移部位所給予之化學治療或接受臨床試驗化學治療，若屬於首次療程，也應記錄於本欄位。
• 編碼00-09、20-21、30-31、88適用於任何原發部位。
• 個案未接受化學治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受化學治療，則編碼為00。
• 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含化學治療的計畫，則編碼為00。
• 肝轉移個案若有接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，應視其治療情況編碼10-13。例如：結腸癌個案(C18.9)在診斷時發現肝轉移，但因個案年邁不適合開刀，個案因肝轉移接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，且針對大腸癌接受5-FU，則此欄位應編碼11。 個案若有接受臨床試驗化學治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。
• 不知道化學治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載化學治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。
• 在治療週期所給予之化學治療，可能是單一或多種化學藥物合併處方。於治療過程中因藥物毒性、不良反應或副作用而修改處方，在未惡化的前提下，主治醫師可能會更換藥物，則此新的處方仍視為首次療程。
• 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據(通常分類為alkylating agents、antimetabolites、natural products or other miscellaneous)。
• 若執行之化學治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。範例：編碼：案例及原因
04：肝癌個案接受 TACE治療。
05：肝癌個案接受 TACE及口服或注射 Fluorouracil 治療。
05：肝癌個案接受IAIC(Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy)或HAIC合併TACE治療。
08：Glioblastoma 個案於手術中接受Gliadel(BCNU wafer)植入。
04：肝內膽管癌個案(C221，cholangiocarcinoma)接受TACE 治療。
09：急性淋巴性血癌個案接受全身性化學治療合併脊髓腔內化學治療。
11：大腸癌合併肝轉移個案接受全身性化學治療及肝臟TACE治療。
21：肺癌末期個案接受臨床試驗化學治療及一般化學治療。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to assess chemotherapy in the first course of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
• Record only the chemotherapy given to the case by the reporting hospital during the first course of treatment. Chemotherapy given to the case by another facility during the first course of treatment is not included.
• Record the chemotherapy given in the first course of treatment, including: systemic chemotherapy, transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), other local chemotherapy and clinical trial chemotherapy.
• Chemotherapy given for metastatic sites or clinical trial chemotherapy should also be recorded in this field if it belongs to the first course of treatment.
• Codes 00-09, 20-21, 30-31 and 88 apply to any primary site.
• If the case did not receive chemotherapy because the type and stage of the case's cancer ordinarily do not require chemotherapy, code 00.
• If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan that did not include chemotherapy, code 00.
• If a case with liver metastasis received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), code 10-13 according to the treatment. For example: a colon cancer case (C18.9) was found to have liver metastasis at diagnosis but was not suitable for surgery because of advanced age; the case received TACE for the liver metastasis and received 5-FU for the colorectal cancer; this field should be coded 11. If the case received clinical trial chemotherapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes the case's participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as receiving clinical trial chemotherapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as receiving clinical trial chemotherapy. If it cannot be determined whether the case was in the experimental or control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case received a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other treatment field.
• If it is not known whether chemotherapy is ordinarily used for the case's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not state whether chemotherapy was recommended or has been given, code 99.
• The chemotherapy given in a treatment cycle may be a single agent or a combination of several chemotherapy drugs. If the regimen is modified during treatment because of drug toxicity, adverse reactions or side effects, and the attending physician changes the drugs without disease progression, the new regimen is still regarded as the first course of treatment.
• For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website can be downloaded as the basis for coding: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx (usually classified as alkylating agents, antimetabolites, natural products or other miscellaneous).
• If the chemotherapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it should also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field. Examples: Code: Case and reason
04: A liver cancer case received TACE.
05: A liver cancer case received TACE and oral or injected Fluorouracil.
05: A liver cancer case received IAIC (Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy) or HAIC combined with TACE.
08: A glioblastoma case received Gliadel (BCNU wafer) implantation during surgery.
04: An intrahepatic bile duct cancer case (C221, cholangiocarcinoma) received TACE.
09: An acute lymphoblastic leukemia case received systemic chemotherapy combined with intrathecal chemotherapy.
11: A colorectal cancer case with liver metastasis received systemic chemotherapy and liver TACE.
21: A terminal-stage lung cancer case received clinical trial chemotherapy and conventional chemotherapy.

fields.purpose_zh: 可進行多種治療模式的排序或是評估多種治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案在申報醫院化學治療開始執行的日期。
• 為確知申報醫院對局部化學治療的開始治療日期，不論局部化學治療是否合併全身性化學治療，申報醫院化學治療開始日期優先填寫局部化學治療開始治療的日期。例如:肝癌個案接受TACE治療，則申報醫院化學治療開始日期以TACE治療日期為優先登錄。局部治療包含脊髓腔內注射(intrathecal)、肋膜腔/心包膜腔注射、腹腔內注射、膀胱灌注及TACE，全身性治療不包括前述局部化學療法。
fields.purpose_en: Allows ordering of multiple treatment modalities and evaluation of the time intervals between treatments.
fields.guide_en:

For example: for a liver cancer case receiving TACE, the date of TACE is recorded preferentially as the start date of chemotherapy at the reporting hospital. Local therapy includes intrathecal injection, pleural/pericardial cavity injection, intraperitoneal injection, intravesical instillation and TACE; systemic therapy does not include the aforementioned local chemotherapy.

fields.description_zh:

欄位位置：128–129
fields.description_en:
Record the hormone/steroid therapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. Hormone/steroid therapy includes many drugs whose action is to control factors affecting cancer growth.
Field position: 128–129
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估申報醫院首次療程的荷爾蒙治療/類固醇。
fields.guide_zh:
• 僅記載申報醫院在首次療程中所給予個案荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的相關情形。不包括外院在首次療程中所給予個案的荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。
• 血液惡性腫瘤(Myeloid leukemia除外)自確定診斷日起接受類固醇治療，不論是否併用化學藥物皆編碼為01
• 若荷爾蒙/類固醇藥物不是用來直接抑制或毒殺腫瘤，而是為了其他療效，例如：降水腫、止吐或促進食慾時，不可登錄此欄位。
• 若prednisone 與化學 藥物，例 如 MOPP(mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone)或CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristin, prednisone)合併給予時，prednisone為類固醇治療，勿認為是化學治療。
• 因腫瘤侵犯或是治療腫瘤時破壞身體製造荷爾蒙的組織器官，為了維持正常新陳代謝及身體功能，會給予荷爾蒙補充治療(Hormone replacement therapy)，此時的荷爾蒙補充治療不可以視為荷爾蒙治療。
• 個案未接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則編碼為00。
• 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的計畫，則編碼為00。
• 個案接受甲狀腺補充治療，目的在於抑制TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone是腦垂腺所產生的，可以刺激促進腫瘤的生長)，則編碼為01。
• 個案若有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。
• 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。
• 不知道荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，就編碼為99。
• 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據。
• 若執行之荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。範例：編碼：理由
00：肺癌併腦轉移個案，醫師開立 Decadron以減少腦部水腫及神經症狀。Decadron並未與化學治療合併給予。
00：乳癌個案因 aminoglutethimide (Cytadren, Elipten)治療，而抑制 glucocorticoids 和mineralocorticoids 的製造，因此給 glucocorticoid (hydrocortisone)或 mineralocorticoid (Florinef)等荷爾蒙補充治療。
00：癌症末期個案給予 prednisone來促進食慾和改善營養狀況。
01：攝護腺癌個案，醫師給予 flutamide (一種antiandrogenic)的荷爾蒙治療。編碼：理由
03：個案診斷為 Diffuse large B cell lymphoma with multiple lymph nodes and CNS involved。採用口服 prednisone 治療，同時接受 intrathecal dexamethasone injection.
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to assess hormone therapy/steroids in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
• Record only the hormone/steroid therapy given to the case by the reporting hospital in the first course of treatment. Hormone/steroid therapy given to the case by another facility in the first course of treatment is not included.
• For hematologic malignancies (except myeloid leukemia), steroid therapy received from the date of confirmed diagnosis is coded 01, whether or not combined with chemotherapy drugs.
• If a hormone/steroid drug is not used to directly suppress or kill the tumor but for another effect, for example reducing edema, preventing vomiting or stimulating appetite, it must not be recorded in this field.
• If prednisone is given together with chemotherapy drugs, such as MOPP (mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone) or CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone), prednisone is steroid therapy and should not be regarded as chemotherapy.
• When tumor invasion, or treatment of the tumor, destroys the tissues or organs that produce hormones in the body, hormone replacement therapy is given to maintain normal metabolism and body function; such hormone replacement therapy must not be regarded as hormone therapy.
• If the case did not receive hormone/steroid therapy because the cancer type and stage of the case usually do not require hormone/steroid therapy, code 00.
• If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan without hormone/steroid therapy, code 00.
• If the case received thyroid replacement therapy for the purpose of suppressing TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone, produced by the pituitary gland, which can stimulate tumor growth), code 01.
• If the case received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the study arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy. If it cannot be known whether the case was in the study arm or the control arm, code 30 or 31.
• If the case participated in a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other therapy field.
• If it is not known whether hormone/steroid therapy is usually used for the cancer type and stage of the case, and the medical record also does not state whether hormone/steroid therapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99.
• For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, download the drug lookup tool on the SEER website: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx as the basis for coding.
• If the hormone/steroid therapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field. Examples: Code: Reason
00: A lung cancer case with brain metastases; the physician prescribed Decadron to reduce brain edema and neurologic symptoms. Decadron was not given together with chemotherapy.
00: A breast cancer case was treated with aminoglutethimide (Cytadren, Elipten), which suppresses the production of glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids, so hormone replacement therapy such as a glucocorticoid (hydrocortisone) or mineralocorticoid (Florinef) was given.
00: A terminal cancer case was given prednisone to stimulate appetite and improve nutritional status.
01: A prostate cancer case; the physician gave hormone therapy with flutamide (an antiandrogen). Code: Reason
03: The case was diagnosed with diffuse large B cell lymphoma with multiple lymph nodes and CNS involved. Treated with oral prednisone, and also received intrathecal dexamethasone injection.

fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估申報醫院首次療程的免疫治療。
fields.guide_zh:
• 僅記載申報醫院在首次療程中所給予個案免疫治療的相關情形。不包括外院在首次療程中所給予個案的免疫治療。
• 免疫治療：透過刺激或抑制免疫系統，來達到治療癌症的效果。可區分為： 細胞介素與免疫調節劑，例如干擾素(interferon)、介白素(interleukin)、Thalidomide、Lenalidomide。 免疫檢查點抑制劑(Immune checkpoint inhibitor)，例如CTLA-4抑制劑、PD-1抑制劑、PD-L1抑制劑。 免疫細胞治療，例如CAR-T細胞療法、NK細胞治療、Sipuleucel T細胞治療。
• 個案未接受免疫治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受免疫治療，則編碼為00。
• 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含免疫治療的計畫，則編碼為00。
• 個案有接受免疫細胞治療，則視治療情況編碼04-07。
• 個案若有接受臨床試驗免疫治療，則視治療情況編碼20-23、30-33。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗免疫治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗免疫治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30-33。
• 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。
• 不知道免疫治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載免疫治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，就編碼為99。
• 若執行之免疫治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。
• 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據。範例：編碼：案例
01：罹患惡性黑色素瘤的個案，接受interferon的免疫治療。
20：個案於 2018 年診斷為肺癌，接受 Carboplatin+Alimta 合併使用免疫治療臨床試驗藥物MEDI4736(Durvalumab)。
21：Renal Medullary Carcinoma 的個案接受免疫藥物 Nivolumab 的治療及臨床試驗免疫藥物 Ipilimumab。
30：個案於 2018 年診斷為口腔癌第三期，接受Cisplatin 合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗Nimotuzumab(TheraCIM h-R3) or Placebo。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to assess immunotherapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
• Record only the immunotherapy given to the case by the reporting hospital during the first course of treatment. Immunotherapy given to the case by another facility during the first course of treatment is not included.
• Immunotherapy: treats cancer by stimulating or suppressing the immune system. It can be divided into: Cytokines and immunomodulators, e.g. interferon, interleukin, Thalidomide, Lenalidomide. Immune checkpoint inhibitors, e.g. CTLA-4 inhibitors, PD-1 inhibitors, PD-L1 inhibitors. Immune cell therapy, e.g. CAR-T cell therapy, NK cell therapy, Sipuleucel T cell therapy.
• If the case did not receive immunotherapy because the type and stage of the case's cancer ordinarily do not require immunotherapy, code 00.
• If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan that did not include immunotherapy, code 00.
• If the case received immune cell therapy, code 04-07 according to the treatment.
• If the case received clinical trial immunotherapy, code 20-23 or 30-33 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes the case's participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as receiving clinical trial immunotherapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as receiving clinical trial immunotherapy. If it cannot be determined whether the case was in the experimental or control arm, code 30-33.
• If the case received a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other treatment field.
• If it is not known whether immunotherapy is ordinarily used for the case's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not state whether immunotherapy was recommended or has been given, code 99.
• If the immunotherapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it should also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field.
• For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website can be downloaded as the basis for coding: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx. Examples: Code: Case
01: A case with malignant melanoma received interferon immunotherapy.
20: A case diagnosed with lung cancer in 2018 received Carboplatin+Alimta combined with the immunotherapy clinical trial drug MEDI4736 (Durvalumab).
21: A case with Renal Medullary Carcinoma received the immunotherapy drug Nivolumab and the clinical trial immunotherapy drug Ipilimumab.
30: A case diagnosed in 2018 with stage III oral cancer received Cisplatin combined with a double-blind immunotherapy clinical trial of Nimotuzumab (TheraCIM h-R3) or Placebo.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在申報醫院首次治療時，給予骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置情形。此等治療包括骨髓移植、幹細胞移植、或以放射線照射或手術切除之內分泌處置。
欄位位置：148–149
fields.description_en:
Record the bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure given to the case at first treatment at the reporting hospital. These treatments include bone marrow transplant, stem cell transplant, or endocrine procedures by irradiation or surgical resection.
Field position: 148–149
fields.purpose_zh: 瞭解與骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置有關的治療型式及照護品質。
fields.guide_zh:
• 骨髓移植包括： 自體的(autologous)：骨髓來自個案本身。 異體的(allogeneic)：骨髓由他人所捐贈。若骨髓移植是同卵雙胞胎的(syngeneic)：骨髓來自同卵雙胞胎中的另一個體，亦視為異體骨髓移植。
• 幹細胞移植是收集個案體內未成熟的血液細胞，於體外處理，並於個案接受化學治療或放射治療後，此時其造血機能正處於恢復的時候，將這些培養過之細胞再輸入個案體內，使得個案得以獲得足夠恢復整個造血機能的血液幹細胞。
• 手術/放射線之內分泌處置，乃藉由抑制個案體內荷爾蒙活性，進而改變或影響以達到長期控制癌細胞的生長的一種治療方式。這些處置必須雙側腺體同時治療才符合手術/放射線之內分泌處置之定義，如果剛開始治療時，僅存單側腺體，則對此一僅存的腺體作手術或放射治療，亦符合本欄位定義。
• 個案未接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，則編碼為00。
• 若有多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇的治療計畫不含骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，則編碼為00。
• 不知道骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載前述治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，就編碼為99。
• 若執行之骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。
• 編碼10-40為記錄個案在申報醫院所接受的骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置。
fields.purpose_en: To understand the treatment patterns and quality of care related to bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures.
fields.guide_en:
• Bone marrow transplant includes:• Autologous: the bone marrow comes from the patient.• Allogeneic: the bone marrow is donated by another person. If the bone marrow transplant is syngeneic, in which the marrow comes from the identical twin, it is also regarded as an allogeneic bone marrow transplant.
• Stem cell transplant collects the patient's immature blood cells, processes them outside the body, and, after the patient has received chemotherapy or radiotherapy, when hematopoietic function is recovering, reinfuses these cultured cells into the patient so that the patient obtains enough blood stem cells to restore the whole hematopoietic function.
• Surgical/radiation endocrine procedures are a treatment method that suppresses the patient's hormone activity so as to alter or influence it and thereby achieve long-term control of cancer cell growth. To meet the definition of a surgical/radiation endocrine procedure, both gland(s) on the two sides must be treated; if only one gland remains at the start of treatment, surgery or radiotherapy on that remaining gland also meets the definition of this field.
• If the patient did not receive bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure because the patient's cancer type and stage usually do not require them, code 00.
• If there were several treatment plans and the patient chose a plan that does not include bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure, code 00.
• If it is not known whether bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure is usually used for the patient's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not document whether such treatment was recommended or has been performed, code 99.
• If the bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure performed is to control symptoms to prolong life, relieve pain or make the patient more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field.
• Codes 10-40 record the bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure the patient received at the reporting hospital.

記錄個案在申報醫院首次療程中，所給予標靶治療相關情形。標靶治療包括多種抗癌藥物，可能與細胞癌化過程有關的分子或是酵素，為一種新的標地性治療藥物直接作用於癌細胞中的異常蛋白，是與癌細胞異常增生或是抗藥性增加有關的細胞訊息傳導路徑、或是促進腫瘤異常的血管增生及癌細胞轉移的調控機轉等。以透過對這些異常機轉的抑制以達到抗癌的治療效果，故此類標靶藥物具有癌細胞專一性。
欄位位置：158–159
fields.description_en:
Record the targeted therapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. Targeted therapy includes many anticancer drugs; it is a new class of targeted drugs that act directly on abnormal proteins in cancer cells, namely molecules or enzymes possibly involved in the process of malignant transformation, cell signaling pathways related to abnormal cancer cell proliferation or increased drug resistance, or regulatory mechanisms that promote abnormal tumor angiogenesis and cancer cell metastasis. Anticancer effects are achieved by inhibiting these abnormal mechanisms, so such targeted drugs are specific to cancer cells.
Field position: 158–159
fields.purpose_zh: 本欄位可評估申報醫院首次療程的標靶治療。
fields.guide_zh:
• 個案未接受標靶治療，標靶治療非首次療程的一部份，則編碼為00。
• 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含標靶治療的計畫，編碼也是00。
• 個案若有接受臨床試驗標靶治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗標靶治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗標靶治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。
• 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。
• 若個案選擇積極監測或予以密切觀察(Active surveillance or watchful waiting)，則本欄位編碼為00。
• 不知道標靶治療治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載標靶治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。
• 若執行之標靶治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。
• 標靶治療藥物請參考SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx中。注意1：以subcategory欄位描述為targeted therapy、 ＿＿＿＿kinase inhibitor、epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor、cytostatic agent、antiangiogenesis agent、mTOR(mammalian target of rapamycin)、monoclonal antibody均登錄為標靶治療；不論category欄位為Chemotherapy或Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)。例外1: Thalidomide或Lenalidomide視為Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)登錄，不可以subcategory中的antiangiogenesis agent登錄為標靶治療。例外2：若subcategory欄位描述為monoclonal antibody的藥物，請優先參考附錄B：常見標靶及免疫藥物清單，依清單內容登錄於標靶或免疫治療欄位中。注意2：除上述標靶治療外，不論subcategory欄位描述為何，皆以category欄位為編碼依據，例如: Ibritumomab，應以Radiation登錄，不可以subcategory中的Radiolabled monoclonal antibody作為編碼依據。範例：編碼：案例
21：第二期乳癌個案接受下列臨床試驗 A Dose-Finding Study of Pertuzumab (Perjeta) in Combination With Trastuzumab (Herceptin)。
30：第四期直腸癌併有肝臟轉移個案接受 Adjuvant Regorafenib Versus Placebo After Curative Treatment of Liver Metastases in a Randomized，Placebo Controlled 的臨床試驗。
fields.purpose_en: This field can be used to evaluate targeted therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
• If the patient did not receive targeted therapy and targeted therapy is not part of the first course of treatment, code 00.
• If the physician offered several treatment plan options and the patient chose a plan that does not include targeted therapy, the code is also 00.
• If the patient received targeted therapy in a clinical trial, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment situation. Note: if the medical record describes the patient as participating in a clinical trial, confirm whether the patient entered the experimental arm; if so, regard the patient as having received clinical trial targeted therapy; if only in the control arm, do not regard the patient as having received clinical trial targeted therapy. If it cannot be determined whether it was the experimental or control arm, code 30 or 31.
• If the patient is in a double-blind trial and it is unclear which drug was used, it should be coded in the field for other treatment.
• If the patient chooses active surveillance or watchful waiting (Active surveillance or watchful waiting), code this field 00.
• If it is not known whether targeted therapy is usually used for the patient's cancer type and stage, and the medical record also does not state whether targeted therapy was recommended or has been given, code 99.
• If the targeted therapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the patient more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field.
• For targeted therapy drugs, refer to the drug lookup tool on the SEER website:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx. Note 1: Drugs whose subcategory field is described as targeted therapy, ____kinase inhibitor, epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor, cytostatic agent, antiangiogenesis agent, mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) or monoclonal antibody are all registered as targeted therapy, regardless of whether the category field is Chemotherapy or Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy). Exception 1: Thalidomide or Lenalidomide is registered as Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy); it must not be registered as targeted therapy under the antiangiogenesis agent subcategory. Exception 2: For drugs whose subcategory field is described as monoclonal antibody, first refer to Appendix B: List of common targeted and immunotherapy drugs, and register in the targeted or immunotherapy field according to the list. Note 2: Except for the targeted therapies above, regardless of what the subcategory field says, the category field is the coding basis; for example, Ibritumomab should be registered as Radiation, and the subcategory Radiolabled monoclonal antibody must not be used as the coding basis. Examples: Code: Case
21: A stage II breast cancer patient received the following clinical trial: A Dose-Finding Study of Pertuzumab (Perjeta) in Combination With Trastuzumab (Herceptin).
30: A stage IV rectal cancer patient with liver metastasis received the clinical trial Adjuvant Regorafenib Versus Placebo After Curative Treatment of Liver Metastases in a Randomized, Placebo Controlled trial.

fields.purpose_zh: 申報醫院可藉本欄位探知其照護為緩和性而非診斷或治癒性目的。
fields.guide_zh:
• 記錄個案在申報醫院首次療程所接受之緩和照護的型態。
• 緩和照護不是作為診斷原發腫瘤或判斷期別之用。
• 經由手術、放射線、局部/全身性藥物治療或其他治療，以控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，皆應記錄為緩和照護。若這些治療將原發或轉移組織移除或改變時，也應填入首次療程的項目中。
• 各種治療引發之疼痛或副作用所執行的相關處理，不可在此欄位逕行編碼。
• 個案經醫師診斷為癌症末期，並評估其首次療程不適合根治性手術、放射治療、全身性治療或其他治療，如有接受住院安寧或居家安寧照護，應編碼為7。
• 根據SEER的Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual：輸血(全血或血小板等)為治療貧血症狀，可視為症狀緩解，而非癌症治療；故若個案僅接受輸血治療，請登錄為緩和治療。範例：編碼：理由
0：沒有給予個案緩和照護。
0：食道癌個案接受同步化學、放射治療，治療期間因化學治療造成血色素過低而輸血。編碼：理由
0：個案於申報醫院診斷為大腸癌執行左側半結腸切除手術，術後予止痛劑減緩傷口疼痛。
7：臨床上懷疑有腎臟癌轉移的個案至申報醫院就診，以非侵入性方式來進行緩和照護。
7：肺癌個案首次療程僅接受居家安寧照護。
9：剛被診斷為乳癌廣泛瀰漫性第四期的個案至申報醫院就診，但醫療記錄中，並未說明個案是否有接受緩和照護。
7：個案接受肋膜沾黏術(pleurodesis)，且使用非抗癌性藥物。
7：因原發部位腫瘤造成的胸水引起症狀，而以胸水抽取術來減輕症狀。抽取的胸水並未送細胞學檢查。
fields.purpose_en: The reporting hospital can use this field to learn that its care was palliative rather than for diagnostic or curative purposes.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the type of palliative care the case received in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
• Palliative care is not for diagnosing the primary tumor or determining stage.
• Any surgery, radiation, local/systemic drug therapy or other treatment given to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable should be recorded as palliative care. If these treatments remove or alter primary or metastatic tissue, they should also be entered in the first course of treatment items.
• Management of pain or side effects caused by various treatments must not be coded in this field directly.
• If the case was diagnosed by a physician as terminal-stage cancer and the first course of treatment was assessed as unsuitable for curative surgery, radiotherapy, systemic therapy or other treatment, and the case received inpatient hospice or home hospice care, code 7.
• According to the SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual: transfusion (whole blood or platelets, etc.) treats the symptoms of anemia and can be regarded as symptom relief rather than cancer treatment; therefore if the case received only transfusion, register it as palliative treatment. Examples: Code: Reason
0: No palliative care was given to the case.
0: An esophageal cancer case received concurrent chemoradiotherapy and was given a blood transfusion during treatment because chemotherapy caused low hemoglobin. Code: Reason
0: A case diagnosed with colorectal cancer at the reporting hospital underwent left hemicolectomy and was given analgesics after surgery to relieve wound pain.
7: A case clinically suspected of renal cancer metastasis came to the reporting hospital and received palliative care by non-invasive means.
7: A lung cancer case received only home hospice care in the first course of treatment.
9: A case newly diagnosed with extensively disseminated stage IV breast cancer came to the reporting hospital, but the medical record does not state whether the case received palliative care.
7: A case underwent pleurodesis using a non-anticancer drug.
7: Symptoms caused by pleural effusion due to the primary site tumor were relieved by thoracentesis. The aspirated pleural fluid was not sent for cytology.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在申報醫院首次療程中，所給予其他治療相關情形。其他治療的定義為未能歸類於手術、放射治療、全身性藥物治療或輔助性治療(ancillary treatment)。
欄位位置：169–170
fields.description_en:
Record the other treatment given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. Other treatment is defined as treatment that cannot be classified as surgery, radiation therapy, systemic drug therapy or ancillary treatment.
Field position: 169–170
fields.purpose_zh: 其他治療的資訊用來敘述及評估照護品質和治療成效。
fields.guide_zh:
 下列處置視為其他治療： UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. 非肝癌個案執行TAE治療。 目前血液惡性腫瘤在支持照護的治療原則上並非一般治療所定義的「改變、控制、移除或破壞」增長的癌症組織；為了解血液惡性腫瘤病人是否有接受支持照護，故若接受放血治療和抗凝血劑，如阿斯匹靈等，則歸於其他治療(編碼01)內收錄。 根據SEER的Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Case Reportability and Coding
Manual：輸血(全血或血小板等)為治療貧血症狀，可視為症狀緩解，而非癌症治療；故若個案僅接受輸血治療，請登錄於「緩和治療」欄位中。 個案若使用PUVA(psoralen and long wave ultraviolet，長波紫外線光化治療)等治療時，應編碼為01。 個案若接受臨床試驗藥物治療，依據藥物種類編碼於化學/荷爾蒙/類固醇/免疫/標靶欄位中，此欄位應編碼為00。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道其他治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載其他治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 另類治療為本手冊未規範定義之各種療法，且個案自行認定該療法對癌症有療效的治療。這些另類療法可包括中草藥、針灸、氣功、生機療法、按摩療法、磁療法、精神療法和冥想，亦包括在未參與癌症診療認證合格的診所或醫療機構所接受被宣稱具有療效的免疫療法等。若個案僅接受另類治療，其不可視為其他治療的一種，應編碼於「治療狀態分類」欄位為5。 若執行之其他治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。 實質腫瘤所接受的治療，若僅為支持照護，輔助治療或症狀減緩(non-cancer direct treatment)，而並非直接針對癌症組織給予"改變、控制、移除或破壞"的處置，則不可視為其他治療。範例：編碼：定義
00：個案於2018年診斷為口腔癌第三期，後續接受Cisplatin合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗 Nimotuzumab or Placebo。
01：新診斷第四期轉移個案至申報醫院，醫師經評估無法以現行的任何治療為個案治療，建議個案接受某雙盲試驗，但無法知道該實驗用藥為何種藥物。
01：ABT-414合併同步化學放射治療以及輔助性 Temozolomide用於新診斷之多型性神經膠母細胞瘤(GBM)並有表皮生長因子受體(EGFR)增殖之受試者的一項隨機分配、安慰劑對照、第 3期試驗 (Intellance1)。
fields.purpose_en: Information on other treatment is used to describe and evaluate quality of care and treatment effectiveness.
fields.guide_en:
• The following procedures are regarded as other treatment:• UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma.• Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY.• Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY.• Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY.• Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY.• Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY• Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY.• TAE treatment performed in a patient without liver cancer.• Under the current principles of supportive care for hematologic malignancies, it does not "modify, control, remove or destroy" growing cancer tissue as ordinary treatment is defined; to learn whether patients with hematologic malignancies received supportive care, phlebotomy and anticoagulants such as aspirin are therefore recorded under other treatment (code 01).• According to the SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Case Reportability and Coding
Manual: transfusion (whole blood, platelets, etc.) treats the symptoms of anemia and may be regarded as symptom relief rather than cancer treatment; therefore, if a patient receives only transfusion, register it in the "Palliative treatment" field.• If a patient receives treatment such as PUVA (psoralen and long wave ultraviolet), code 01.• If a patient receives a clinical-trial drug, code it in the chemotherapy/hormone/steroid/immunotherapy/targeted therapy fields according to the type of drug, and code this field as 00.• If a patient takes part in a double-blind trial and it is unclear which drug is used, code it in the other treatment field.• If it is not known whether the other treatment is usually used for the patient's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not document whether the other treatment was recommended or has been performed, code 99.• Alternative therapy refers to therapies not defined in this manual that the patient self-identifies as effective against cancer. These may include Chinese herbal medicine, acupuncture, qigong, organic/biological therapy, massage, magnetic therapy, psychotherapy and meditation, and also immunotherapy received at a clinic or facility without cancer-care accreditation that claims therapeutic effect. If a patient receives only alternative therapy, it must not be regarded as a kind of other treatment; code 5 in the "Treatment status classification" field.• If the other treatment given is to control symptoms to prolong life, relieve pain or make the patient more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field.• For treatment given to a solid tumor that is only supportive care, adjuvant treatment or symptom relief (non-cancer direct treatment), and is not directed at the cancer tissue to "modify, control, remove or destroy" it, it must not be regarded as other treatment. fields.purpose_en: Obesity is a carcinogenic risk factor. To understand the case's obesity status, the body mass index (BMI) is needed, and height is a value required to calculate BMI.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the case's height as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the first course of cancer treatment.
• Abstract the case's height value directly, rounded to the nearest integer. Height below 100cm: if the rounded value has fewer than three digits, pad with 0; for example, height 75.3cm is coded 075. Height of 100cm or more: if the rounded value has three digits, abstract it directly; for example, height 102.5cm is coded 103.

fields.purpose_en: Smoking is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the patient's smoking behavior as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the date of initial diagnosis.
• If the medical record has no smoking information before the date of initial diagnosis, abstract the smoking information documented in the most recent medical record before the first course of treatment of the cancer.
• This field has 6 digits, explained as follows:• Digits 1-2 are the daily amount smoked (in cigarettes); if the daily amount is ≧90 cigarettes, code 90.• Digits 3-4 are the years of smoking.• Digits 5-6 are the years since quitting; if the time since quitting is less than 1 month (30 days), the patient is regarded as not having quit.
• If the amount smoked, years of smoking, years since quitting or similar information has a decimal, always round up. For example: smoking for 1.3 years is coded 02 for years of smoking.
• If the amount smoked, years of smoking, years since quitting or similar information is only a rough value, abstract the maximum value. Example 1: Daily amount 5-6 cigarettes, smoking 3-5 years, quit 1-2 years: code 060502. Example 2: Daily amount >6 cigarettes, smoking >5 years, quit >2 years: code 060502.
• If the medical record documents only smoking (+) with no values, code 989800; for those who never smoked, code 000088 (not applicable).
• If the medical record has no documentation or the smoking status is completely unknown, code 999999.1 3 0 Part 2 Coding Guide: Other factors This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Example:
